Job Description:

Shield AI builds intelligent systems that protect service members and civilians. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software and V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and our teams support customers and operations across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. 

Shield AI is hiring a Senior Customer Sustainment Engineer to support Hivemind systems after they reach customers and operational teams. This role sits at the intersection of customer support, systems troubleshooting, and engineering. 

Customers and forward deployed employees bring valuable operational context when they report a mission interruption, update concern, or unexpected system behavior. You will work with them to translate that context into a clear technical problem by gathering the right evidence, understanding the operating environment, narrowing the likely causes, and identifying the best path to resolution. 

Some issues will be resolved through configuration changes, deployment corrections, known workarounds, or better guidance. Others will require a product or engineering change. In either case, you will stay with the issue through resolution, keep the customer informed, and make sure the outcome is captured for future use. 

The role is the primary owner for Tier 1 support, handles a meaningful portion of Tier 2 troubleshooting, and can contribute to limited Tier 3 investigation when deeper technical experience is useful. Using DoD sustainment language, this is roughly the software equivalent of intermediate-level maintenance: resolve what can be addressed at that level, identify what needs depot-level repair, and provide engineering with a complete technical handoff. Product Support and core engineering teams provide the depot-level repair capability, while this role stays engaged to validate the result and close the loop with the customer. 

You will work closely with Forward Deployment Engineering, Product Support Engineering, Operations & Sustainment, Product, Program, Licensing, and the core Hivemind engineering teams. The goal is straightforward: help customers return to mission-ready operation while making Hivemind easier to support over time. 

What you'll do:

    • Own Tier 1 customer support and incident coordination from initial report through confirmed resolution. 

    • Gather the information needed to understand an issue, including mission impact, software version, configuration, deployment state, logs, telemetry, screenshots, network context, and reproduction steps. 

    • Troubleshoot Hivemind software, APIs, licensing and provisioning, deployments, configurations, networks, operator workflows, and partner or OEM integrations. 

    • Separate product defects from configuration problems, environmental differences, integration issues, training needs, and feature requests. 

    • Resolve common technical problems, handle appropriate Tier 2 investigations, and reproduce more complex failures in lab, simulation, or representative test environments. 

    • Recognize issues that require Tier 3 or depot-level product repair and give engineering teams concise escalation packages that explain the impact, evidence, likely causes, work already attempted, and expected result. 

    • Provide customers with clear updates, practical next steps, and technically sound workarounds while investigations are in progress. 

    • Support software releases, upgrades, onboarding, licensing and provisioning workflows, and the transition from deployment into ongoing sustainment. 

    • Turn recurring issues into troubleshooting guides, known-issue records, diagnostic tools, training material, and product feedback. 

    • Use incident patterns to identify improvements to product reliability, diagnostics, documentation, and release readiness. 

Projects you may work on:

    • Investigate a mission failure after a software update by comparing logs, configurations, versions, network behavior, telemetry, and release notes. 

    • Reproduce an autonomy, API, or integration issue and provide engineering with the evidence needed to correct it. 

    • Restore an offline customer environment affected by licensing, provisioning, time synchronization, or version compatibility. 

    • Coordinate the technical response to a high-impact customer issue and validate the workaround or fix before closure. 

    • Build a diagnostic playbook for recurring deployment, configuration, networking, or operator-workflow problems. 

Required qualifications:

    • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical, military, field-engineering, or technical experience. 

    • 7+ years of hands-on experience supporting fielded, software-enabled systems in customer, operational, test, deployment, or sustainment environments. 

    • Experience with cyber-physical, edge, mission, robotics, autonomy, aviation, defense, industrial-control, or similarly complex deployed systems. 

    • Strong troubleshooting skills across software, Linux, configuration, networking, logs, telemetry, software versions, and hardware-adjacent interfaces. 

    • A record of owning technical issues from an incomplete initial report through diagnosis and resolution. 

    • Ability to read and reason about modern C++ and use existing Python, Bash, or similar scripts during troubleshooting and log analysis. 

    • Clear written and verbal communication with customers, operators, and engineering teams, including during time-sensitive situations. 

    • Ability to write useful incident records, troubleshooting guidance, engineering escalations, and customer-facing updates. 

    • Sound judgment when working within security, export-control, safety, customer-site, contractual, and data-handling requirements. 

    • Ability to possess a Secret DoD security clearance when required by customers. 

Preferred qualifications:

    • Experience with autonomy software, robotics, unmanned systems, aviation, defense or mission software, ground-control software, SDKs, APIs, or edge-deployed systems. 

    • Experience supporting fleet operations, operational-readiness events, flight or ground test campaigns, or customer-site deployments. 

    • Familiarity with DoD sustainment, intermediate- and depot-level maintenance concepts, or comparable field-to-engineering support models. 

    • Hands-on software engineering experience writing and debugging C++ and developing Python scripts or tools for diagnostics, automation, or data analysis. 

    • Familiarity with software releases, configuration baselines, upgrade validation, rollback, and version compatibility. 

    • Experience with licensing, provisioning, offline or air-gapped environments, edge compute, time synchronization, networking, or telemetry analysis. 

    • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Confluence, or similar engineering and support tools. 

    • Military, operator, maintainer, field-service, mission-support, or customer-engineering experience. 

    • Active or prior security clearance.

      Success looks like 

      After 90 days 

      • You can independently manage Tier 1 Hivemind support, resolve appropriate Tier 2 problems, and bring well-supported Tier 3 or depot-level cases to the appropriate engineering team. 

      • Customers and internal teams receive clear updates, practical next steps, and consistent follow-through. 

      • Your escalation packages allow engineering teams to begin useful work without repeating basic discovery. 

      After 6 months 

      • Common field issues have repeatable diagnostics, workarounds, and support guidance. 

      • Forward Deployment Engineers and core engineers spend less time reconstructing customer problems because the evidence and technical qualification are already in place. 

      • Incident trends are leading to improvements in Hivemind reliability, supportability, documentation, and release readiness.

Job Description

Are you an experienced aircraft-development leader looking to help build a new class of autonomous combat aircraft? Are you energized by technically difficult problems, rapid execution, and the opportunity to redefine airpower? Shield AI may be the place for you.

The Deputy Chief Engineer for X-BAT will report to the Air Vehicle Lead / Chief Engineer X-BAT and serve as their primary technical deputy across the design, development, integration, test, and maturation of the X-BAT air vehicle.

This individual will help maintain the technical integrity of the aircraft while driving day-to-day engineering execution across structures, aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, electrical systems, flight controls, software, autonomy integration, manufacturing, and flight test.

The ideal candidate combines broad aircraft technical depth with strong systems thinking, sound engineering judgment, and a demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through ambiguity. They must be comfortable moving between system-level decisions and detailed technical problem-solving while balancing performance, safety, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and mission requirements.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary technical deputy to the X-BAT Air Vehicle Lead, acting on their behalf when necessary and helping translate program objectives into clear engineering priorities.
  • Maintain the integrity of the air vehicle’s technical baseline, including system requirements, architecture, interfaces, configuration, performance, verification, and airworthiness evidence.
  • Lead the day-to-day integration of engineering activities across aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, electrical systems, flight controls, software, autonomy, manufacturing, and test.
  • Drive aircraft-level technical decisions and trade studies, ensuring decisions are grounded in first-principles analysis and consider downstream effects on performance, safety, cost, schedule, producibility, maintainability, and operations.
  • Establish and maintain a disciplined technical-risk process, ensuring risks are identified early, assigned accountable owners, supported by mitigation plans, and retired through analysis or test.
  • Lead major technical and design reviews, ensuring the aircraft is sufficiently mature to progress through fabrication, ground test, flight test, qualification, and production.
  • Partner with Program Management to align technical scope with schedule, budget, staffing, supplier, and customer commitments.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing and Supply Chain to ensure designs are producible, scalable, and supported by a resilient supplier base.
  • Partner with Test and Flight Operations to define verification strategies, ground- and flight-test objectives, instrumentation requirements, test readiness criteria, and issue-resolution plans.
  • Lead rapid root-cause investigations and corrective actions for complex aircraft-level problems identified during integration, ground test, flight test, production, or operations.
  • Ensure technical decisions and engineering changes are documented, communicated, and reflected in the controlled product baseline.
  • Develop the technical leadership capabilities of engineering managers, functional leads, integrated product team leads, and senior individual contributors.
  • Communicate aircraft status, technical risks, decision recommendations, and recovery plans clearly to program leadership, executives, customers, and external partners.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, urgency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and constructive challenge.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience developing complex aircraft, military aerospace systems, autonomous aircraft, or similarly integrated aerospace products.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership on an aircraft-development program, preferably as a Chief Engineer, Deputy Chief Engineer, Air Vehicle Lead, Systems Engineering Lead, Integrated Product Team Lead, or equivalent.
  • Broad understanding of aircraft design and integration across multiple engineering disciplines, with the technical judgment to identify critical interfaces and system-level consequences.
  • Experience taking an aircraft or similarly complex aerospace system through multiple lifecycle stages, such as requirements development, preliminary and critical design, fabrication, integration, ground test, flight test, qualification, or production.
  • Experience establishing and managing system requirements, technical baselines, interface definitions, design reviews, verification plans, and engineering risks.
  • Demonstrated ability to make high-quality technical decisions with incomplete information and under aggressive program timelines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues and recommendations to executive and customer audiences.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Management, or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing clean-sheet military aircraft, fighter aircraft, collaborative combat aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems, or advanced VTOL platforms.
  • Experience with propulsion integration, flight controls, vehicle management systems, autonomy integration, low-observable aircraft, or weapons and mission-systems integration.
  • Experience supporting aircraft ground test, envelope expansion, developmental flight test, airworthiness, and mishap-risk reduction.
  • Familiarity with military airworthiness frameworks, verification and validation processes, configuration management, and model-based systems engineering.
  • Experience transitioning an aircraft from rapid prototype development into qualification, rate production, and operational deployment.
  • Experience working directly with the Department of Defense, military service customers, external suppliers, and strategic industry partners.
  • Background in a high-growth aerospace organization where speed, individual ownership, and first-principles thinking were essential to program success.

  • Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, cloud build clusters).

  • Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI pipelines.

Job Description:

The Director, International Growth Campaign Leader leads the internal operating system behind Shield AI international X-BAT pursuits. Regional, country and opportunity-focused Go-To-Market (GTM) leaders own their customers, their regional and in-country strategies, and their individual captures. This role owns the layer above them: the single, integrated view across regions, and the mechanisms that turn that view into faster decisions, earlier risk mitigation, and better-supported GTM leads. 

Each GTM lead sees their own campaign clearly. No one else sees the whole international board. This role does. It connects individual pursuits to shared dependencies — U.S. Government approvals, foreign disclosure and export sequencing, engineering and product capacity, aircraft and test availability, indirect investment, partner and industrial strategy — and makes sure competing regional timelines and strategies are sequenced deliberately rather than reactively. 

This is a pre-award enablement and integration role. It is explicitly not the primary customer interface, and it does not extend to the execution of customer-funded programs after award, though it may involve developing projections to better inform execution-supporting decision making. The GTM lead remains the face to the customer, the owner of the account plan, and the accountable capture lead for their country. This role makes those leads faster, better armed, and better supported. 

What you'll do:

  • Own the global view. Build and maintain the integrated international campaign picture across all X-BAT regional and country pursuits: strategy status, critical path, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and campaign health in one authoritative picture. 
  • Enable the GTM leads. Give regional and country GTM leads the templates, playbooks, data, competitive inputs, cost and schedule inputs, and cross-functional access they need to build and execute their capture plan. Your success is measured by their outcomes. 
  • Synchronize across company functions. Ensure engineering, product, export, legal, contracts, finance, government relations, and business operations have common understanding of a single prioritized international campaign plan, so GTM leads are not individually negotiating for the same scarce resources. 
  • Map the U.S. Government and approval critical path. Maintain the enterprise view of FMS, DCS, and hybrid pathway dependencies — foreign disclosure, exportability, releasability, technology security, and interagency approval sequencing — and translate them into country-level timeline implications the GTM leads can act on. Government Relations and the relevant functional owners lead those engagements; this role ensures they are planned early, sequenced correctly, and never discovered late. Understand and communicate the global GTM projections in ways that support enabling functions’ ability to anticipate and properly resource for future demand. 
  • Surface conflicts between campaigns. Identify where two or more regional campaigns compete for the same aircraft, test window, engineering effort, approval bandwidth, or indirect dollar, and bring executive leadership a clear tradeoff and a recommendation. 
  • Drive executive decision quality. Run the operating cadence — campaign reviews, gate reviews, risk registers, action tracking, and executive dashboards — so leadership receives timely, accurate, decision-ready information on overall international capture health in support of resource allocation. Steward indirect investment. Work with Finance and Business Operations to track campaign investment, indirect spend, and resource planning against campaign priorities and expected return. 
  • Scale the discipline. Capture lessons learned across international efforts and convert them into repeatable tools, templates, metrics, and playbooks so each new campaign starts further ahead than the last. 
  • Support a culture of accountability, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Decision rights and interfaces:

    This role is accountable for: the integrated international campaign plan; the operating cadence and campaign-health reporting; identification and escalation of cross-campaign dependencies, conflicts, and risks; the consolidated U.S. Government approval and disclosure roadmap; and recommendations on investment prioritization and sequencing. 

    Regional, country and opportunity GTM leads are accountable for: customer relationships and engagement, in-country strategy, partner and industrial development, win strategy and price-to-win for their pursuit, proposal content, and the bid/no-bid recommendation for their opportunity. 

    Government Relations, Export, Legal, and Contracts are accountable for: interagency and embassy engagement, export authorizations, disclosure determinations, legal positions, and contracting terms. 

    Engineering and Product are accountable for: technical solution definition, configuration decisions, and performance commitments. 

    Strategy and Operations is responsible for enterprise, cross-product strategy, of which the products this role directly supports would be a part. Program Management is accountable for: execution of customer-funded programs after award. 
     
    This role will be complemented by a parallel position whose focus will be on integration across all U.S. customers, and with whom close collaboration will be required.  

    External customer engagement by this role is in support of, and at the invitation of, the responsible GTM lead. 

Required qualifications:

  • 12+ years in international B2G capture management, program management, strategic operations, business operations, technical program management, or a comparable cross-functional leadership role.  
  • Demonstrated success leading highly complex initiatives with multiple interdependent workstreams across engineering, business development, operations, finance, and executive leadership. 
  • Working knowledge of international defense pursuit dependencies, including FMS, DCS, or hybrid acquisition pathways and the approval, disclosure, and exportability sequencing that governs them. 
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and to drive accountability across functions and geographies. 
  • Strong executive communication: leadership briefings, dashboards, metrics, and decision-support materials that lead to decisions rather than discussion. 
  • Deep operational rigor in integrated schedules, critical path, milestones, action tracking, dependency management, and risk mitigation. 
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments with competing priorities across multiple time zones. 
  • A service orientation toward the functional roles this position supports, and the judgment to know when to escalate versus resolve quietly. 
  • Demonstrated alignment with Shield AI core values: Do What Honor Dictates, Live as a Servant Leader, Pursue Excellence. 
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required, and to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of War, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, aviation, or defense-technology organizations.  
  • Experience within B2G business development, capture, proposal operations, strategic planning, or growth organizations running multiple concurrent international pursuits. 
  • Familiarity with U.S. Government international engagement mechanisms such as foreign disclosure processes, security cooperation planning, embassy and country team coordination, or interagency advocacy. 
  • Experience building executive dashboards, KPIs, operational scorecards, or portfolio health metrics. 
  • Experience supporting executive staff, chief-of-staff organizations, Strategy and Operations teams, or enterprise PMOs. 
  • Experience with tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, or The AI Work Platform for People & Agents | monday.com . 
  • MBA or advanced degree; PMP, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma certification. 

Success in this role:

  • Every regional campaign has an approved strategy, a critical-path schedule, and a mapped approval pathway that the GTM lead owns and uses. 
  • GTM leads report that the role makes their campaigns easier to run, not heavier to report on. 
  • U.S. Government, export, and disclosure dependencies are identified early enough to change the outcome rather than explain it. 
  • Cross-campaign resource and timing conflicts reach leadership early enough for meaningful action, and as a decision with a recommendation. 
  • Executive leadership can see, at any time, an accurate health picture of the international X-BAT portfolio and make investment calls with confidence. 
  • Campaign mechanisms are reused across countries, and each new pursuit stands up measurably faster than the previous one.

Shield AI is seeking a Director of Mission Systems to lead multidisciplinary teams spanning operational analysis, aircraft survivability, communications, and integrated mission systems for our next-generation autonomous aircraft. This leader will establish the organization’s technical and business strategy, align investments and priorities with product and program objectives, and oversee execution from early concept development through integration, flight test, and fielding.
 
The ideal candidate has led a multidisciplinary organization supporting complex military aircraft or autonomous systems and brings strong business acumen alongside sound technical judgment. This individual need not be a subject-matter expert in every discipline but must understand how operational analysis, survivability, communications, payloads, avionics, autonomy, and weapons integration combine to drive mission effectiveness.
 
What You’ll Do
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning operational analysis, survivability, communications, and integrated mission systems.
  • Establish clear priorities, accountability, organizational objectives, and operating rhythms that enable teams to execute effectively.
    Define technical strategy, capability roadmaps, and investment priorities aligned with aircraft program objectives, customer requirements, and broader business goals.
  • Oversee the development of integrated mission-system architectures encompassing sensors, payloads, avionics, weapons, secure communications, autonomy, and aircraft survivability.
  • Direct modeling, simulation, wargaming, and system-of-systems analysis to evaluate mission effectiveness, operational performance, emerging threats, and aircraft design alternatives.
  • Lead cross-functional trade studies that balance mission capability, survivability, technical risk, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and program maturity.
  • Ensure disciplined execution from requirements definition and architecture development through hardware-in-the-loop testing, signature validation, flight test, certification, and fielding.
  • Partner with engineering, product, program management, business development, and aircraft leadership to deliver integrated and mission-relevant capabilities.
  • Engage DoD customers, operators, suppliers, and government stakeholders to shape requirements, refine concepts of operations, support key decisions, and communicate the operational value of Shield AI’s solutions.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop people managers and senior technical leaders while building organizational depth and succession capability.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable system-safety, airworthiness, cybersecurity, security, and certification requirements.
 
Required Qualifications
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, mathematics, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting complex military aircraft, autonomous systems, or other aerospace and defense programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing a multidisciplinary engineering organization that includes people managers and senior technical leaders.
  • Broad working knowledge across multiple relevant disciplines, including mission systems, operational analysis, modeling and simulation, survivability, secure communications, avionics, sensors, payloads, or weapons integration.
  • Experience establishing organizational and technical strategies while managing technical, programmatic, and organizational risk.
  • Proven ability to balance mission performance and engineering requirements with cost, schedule, product maturity, and business priorities.
  • Experience overseeing complex aircraft capabilities across the product lifecycle—from requirements and architecture through integration, test, certification, fielding, and sustainment.
  • Executive-level communication skills with demonstrated success influencing customers, operators, business leaders, engineering teams, and government stakeholders.
    U.S. citizenship with an active Secret security clearance and the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance and required SAP/SAR accesses.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Leadership experience on military UAS, advanced autonomous aircraft, collaborative combat aircraft, or fifth-generation fighter programs involving integrated mission systems and survivability.
  • Demonstrated success advancing a product or major capability from customer shaping and early concept development through acquisition, integration, flight test, validation, and tactical deployment.
  • Experience overseeing multi-domain operational analysis, CONOPS development, force-on-force modeling, threat assessment, or survivability analysis in contested environments.
  • Working knowledge of model-based systems engineering and SysML, DoD acquisition and JCIDS processes, electronic warfare, low-observable communications, and AI-enabled sensors or payloads.
  • Experience developing modular, open-system mission architectures that support rapid capability insertion and third-party payload integration.
  • Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and experience supporting classified DoD or Intelligence Community programs.

As the Director of SOX Compliance, you will build, lead, and continuously improve the company's Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance program in support of a high-growth, public-company environment. Reporting to the Corporate Controller (or Chief Accounting Officer), you will partner closely with Finance, Internal Audit, IT, Engineering, HR, Legal, and business leaders to ensure an effective internal control environment while enabling business growth.

This is initially an individual contributor leadership role (Radford P6) with significant cross-functional influence and executive visibility. As the organization grows, this role is expected to evolve into a people management position with responsibility for building and leading a SOX compliance team.

What you'll do:

  • Own and lead the company's end-to-end SOX 404 compliance program, including business process, entity-level, and IT general controls (ITGCs).
  • Develop and maintain the annual SOX strategy, risk assessment, scoping, testing plan, and compliance calendar.
  • Partner with control owners to document, assess, and improve key business processes and internal controls.
  • Coordinate management's annual SOX assessment and support external audit requirements to ensure timely completion.
  • Evaluate control deficiencies, facilitate root cause analysis, and drive remediation efforts through successful closure.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and evolving best practices to continuously enhance the SOX program.
  • Collaborate with Finance Transformation, ERP, and business system implementation teams to ensure appropriate controls are designed into new processes and technologies.
  • Drive automation and continuous monitoring opportunities to improve efficiency and control effectiveness.
  • Develop executive-level reporting and present SOX program status, risks, and remediation progress to senior leadership and Audit Committee stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders on internal controls, governance, and risk management.
  • Establish and maintain SOX policies, methodologies, documentation standards, and training programs.
  • Support broader internal control, governance, and enterprise risk initiatives as needed.
  • Help define the future organizational structure of the SOX function, including recruiting, mentoring, and developing team members as the program expands.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA, CIA, or equivalent professional certification.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, external audit, accounting, or internal controls.
  • Experience leading SOX programs for publicly traded companies or organizations preparing for public company readiness.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX 404 requirements, COSO Internal Control Framework, and SEC reporting environment.
  • Experience with business process controls, entity-level controls, and IT general controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience managing external auditors and coordinating complex compliance activities across multiple functions.
  • Excellent project management, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership.
  • Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities while maintaining a strong control environment.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or process improvement experience.

  • Familiar with scripting and automation

We are seeking a Propulsion Performance Engineer to own engine calibration and performance for the reciprocating engines that power the V-BAT platform. This role serves as the technical owner for engine calibration strategy — driving test plans, ECU tuning, and performance analysis from bench through flight test — and is accountable for the torque, power, speed, and fuel efficiency characteristics the engine delivers across its full operating envelope.

You'll work hands-on with engine hardware, electronic fuel injection and engine control systems, and engine test stands, creating and executing engine testing strategies under the direction of senior staff propulsion engineers. Candidates with a background in air-cooled or aviation two-stroke engines are especially encouraged to apply; at minimum, we're looking for someone with deep hands-on experience on reciprocating engines (four-stroke or two-stroke) who can own calibration decisions with minimal oversight. 

What You'll Do In This Role

  • Support the engine calibration strategy by defining test plans, calibration methodology, and acceptance criteria across dynamometer, bench, and flight test campaigns.
  • Perform ECU configuration and tuning (including fuel mapping, ignition timing, and injector phasing) to optimize engine performance, fuel efficiency, and reliability across the operating envelope.
  • Analyze and deliver torque, power, and fuel consumption results, identifying calibration or hardware improvement opportunities and driving corrective action.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause investigations for engine testing for the development team and production teams.
  • Reduce and interpret test and flight data to validate performance against requirements, closing gaps between design intent and measured behavior.
  • Represent engine calibration and performance in design reviews, technical readiness checkpoints, and cross-functional discussions with design, controls, and flight test teams.
  • Develop and maintain calibration documentation, procedures, and performance reporting to support program milestones.
  • Support refinement of performance models for the propulsion system and the vehicle through targeted test campaigns and data review.

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 2-3 years of experience in a mechanical or aerospace engineering role, with a focus on engine performance or calibration.
  • Deep hands-on experience with reciprocating (piston) engines.
  • Demonstrated experience with electronically controlled fuel injectors and fuel injection systems.
  • Proven experience with ECU configuration and engine calibration, including ownership of calibration decisions.
  • Strong ability to analyze and interpret engine torque, power, and fuel consumption data to drive engine design, ECU calibration, and vehicle performance decisions.
  • U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

  • Podium finish in FSAE competition, with at least one first place trophy in any dynamic event.
  • Background in air-cooled engines, particularly aviation two-stroke platforms.
  • Experience with dynamometer test cells and associated data acquisition systems.
  • Deep familiarity with fuel maps, ignition timing strategies, and closed-loop engine control logic.
  • Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data reduction and calibration tooling.
  • Experience writing custom data analysis tools to automate engine performance analysis and calibration workflows.
  • Experience supporting military propulsion systems, tactical aircraft, or high-performance aerospace platforms.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Are you a passionate and innovative thermal engineer looking to help develop state-of-the-art AI and aircraft products? Are you eager to make a positive difference in the world? Do you want to work alongside mission driven and values focused teammates? Shield AI is just the place for you!

As a Thermal Engineer at Shield AI, you will own the design, analysis, and integration of thermal management systems for the launch and recovery system structural and electronics components. This role is best suited for an engineer who thrives on first-principles problem solving, is comfortable with ambiguous, open-ended challenges, and can communicate well across functions, ensuring well- coordinated thermal management solutions.

You’ll work across disciplines to ensure structural integrity, manufacturability, and mission-readiness in one of the most advanced autonomous aircraft platforms being built today. This role is ideal for an experienced thermal engineer who thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments and is passionate about building systems that matter.

What you'll do:

  • Own thermal solutions for the autonomous aircraft launch and recovery system
  • Develop and validate analytical, numerical, and computational models for heat transfer and fluid flow using hand calculations and CFD tools such as FloEFD.
  • Prototype, test, and iterate mechanism designs for functionality and reliability
  • Provide technical leadership in trade studies, system architecture decisions, and risk assessments.
  • Drive test planning, instrumentation, and data analysis to correlate models with experimental results.
  • Proactively identify risks, propose solutions, and influence mechanical, electrical and/or PCBA design direction.
  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, avionics, flight controls, manufacturing, and test teams
  • Support pre-production builds, prototype integration, and ground/flight testing on the pathway to production and field deployment
  • Participate in design reviews, architecture discussions, and technical decision-making forums related to structural systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve design processes, configuration management, and team workflows for increased engineering velocity and design quality.

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in thermal engineering.
  • Strong expertise in heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and fluid mechanics.
  • Strong understanding of active and passive cooling solutions and their integration at component and system level.
  • Understanding of thermal management design elements including TIMs, spreaders, heat sinks, vapor chambers, heat pipes, and fans
  • Proficiency with thermal analysis and CFD tools (e.g., ANSYS Icepak, FloEFD, STAR-CCM+).
  • Experience with CAD design tools such as NX, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience applying first-principles reasoning to complex engineering problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to learn and adapt quickly to new tools, processes, and technical challenges in a fast paced, startup environment.
  • A demonstrated record of working hard, being trustworthy, holding yourself to high standards, and being kind to others
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • M.S. in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with thermal and fluid system testing, instrumentation, and validation.
  • Knowledge of materials and manufacturing methods relevant to thermal management
  • MIL-STD-810, structural, or actuated mechanism testing experience
  • Ability to thrive in startup, R&D, or defense innovation environments

Shield AI is seeking a Manager of Actuated Systems to lead an aircraft mechanical systems team for our groundbreaking jet-engine VTOL military UAV platform, X-BAT. You will manage a team of engineers designing and integrating flight- and mission-critical mechanisms such as doors, uplocks/downlocks, landing gear, folding/packaging mechanisms, flight-control actuation integration, and propulsion/nozzle actuation mechanisms. You will support your team in making key architectural decisions, by being a key technical resource, and by being a strong leader of great engineers.
 
Projects that you might work on:
X-BAT Doors, FCAS, Landing Gear, Up/Down Locks
 

What you'll do:

  • Lead and develop a team of high talent mechanical engineers, from new grad to Principal, focused on aircraft mechanisms and actuation systems (architecture, detailed design, analysis support, release, and sustaining).
  • Support your team as a technical resource for end-to-end design of mechanisms including (as applicable):
  • Doors & latching
  • Uplocks / Downlocks
  • Landing gear mechanisms
  • Actuation integration for flight controls
  • Nozzle / propulsion actuation mechanisms
  • Actuation, Hydraulics
  • Set the quality bar for mechanisms engineering: what “good” looks like in sizing, tolerances, margins, drawings/MBD, materials/process selection, and verification evidence.
  • Enable extreme ownership by ensuring engineers have clear goals, interfaces, resources, and decision rights
  • Drive effective cross-functional collaboration (systems, structures/loads, aero, propulsion, GNC, avionics, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, test, flight test) by fostering excelling communication across interfaces.
  • Coach and develop engineers through technical mentorship, career development, feedback, hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Manage team workload across multiple builds and test campaigns; communicate risk, staffing needs, and schedule impacts with transparency.

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years experience with aerospace mechanisms and actuated system design, build, integration, test and flight.
  • 2+ years leading teams or performing in a team leadership role.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams with high autonomy—setting direction, ensuring quality, and scaling output through people.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: kinematics, statics/dynamics, fatigue/wear, tolerancing/GD&T, materials and finishes, lubrication/bearings, failure modes.
  • Experience shipping hardware through prototype build, test, iteration, and release, including supplier and manufacturing engagement.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with environmental and operational robustness (vibration/shock, thermal extremes, contamination, corrosion, sand/dust, etc.).
  • Experience supporting ground test and flight test campaigns and mechanism failure investigations.
  • Familiarity with reliability and safety methods (DFMEA/FTA, fault containment, safe-state thinking) in collaboration with systems safety.

This individual will serve as a trusted partner to the CMO, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations while anticipating needs, managing competing priorities, and enabling the Marketing leadership team to operate efficiently. 

In addition to supporting the CMO, this role will provide administrative support to members of the Marketing leadership team as needed, particularly for complex travel, scheduling, and key initiatives. The role may also serve as backup to the Executive Assistant supporting the Chief People Officer and Chief Legal Officer, and occasionally the Executive Assistant to the CEO. 

This role requires on-site presence at our San Mateo office, particularly on days when the CMO and other Executive Team members are in the office. While there is some flexibility, there will be weeks where being on-site up to five days is required. Occasional travel may also be required to provide executive support during major company events, customer engagements, and industry conferences.

    This is far more than a traditional executive support position. The Executive Assistant will serve as a trusted business partner, helping the CMO and Marketing leadership team stay organized, informed, and focused on the company's highest priorities. Success in this role requires exceptional judgment, professionalism, curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

What we're looking for:

    The ideal candidate is a mature, low-ego professional who thrives behind the scenes, anticipates needs before they arise, and brings calm, sound judgment to every situation. They possess exceptional attention to detail, outstanding organizational skills, and the executive presence to interact confidently with senior leaders, Board members, customers, and external partners. They are naturally curious about the business, eager to learn, and motivated to become a trusted advisor who enables executive success rather than simply managing logistics.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. The Director of Field Marketing, Europe will establish and scale Shield AI’s field marketing function across Europe, with responsibility for supporting priority market development and programs in Africa as needed.

This leader will build the strategy, operating model, processes, and team required to deepen engagement with strategic government, defense, military, and industry stakeholders; accelerate priority opportunities; and create measurable pipeline impact.

This is a player-coach role in a high-growth environment. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable setting regional strategy and executing programs in the field. They thrive in ambiguity, can build new capabilities from the ground up, and adapt quickly as Shield AI expands its international go-to-market presence.

Based in London, this role will work closely with regional Growth, Business Development, Capture, Sales, Communications, and product teams. It will require regular travel across Europe and periodic travel to Africa.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and scale field marketing across Europe, aligned closely with Shield AI’s regional Go-to-Market, Growth, Business Development, Capture, and Sales priorities.
  • Develop the regional field marketing strategy for priority European defense, government, military, and industry accounts, while supporting select opportunities and events in Africa.
  • Build and institutionalize field marketing as a disciplined, account-led, revenue-aligned function within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Develop and execute account-based marketing strategies for priority accounts, mapping buying groups and orchestrating multi-touch engagement across executive briefings, targeted events, customer programs, partner activity, and integrated campaigns.
  • Build engagement strategies tailored to key defense and government stakeholders, including senior military leaders, defense ministry officials, program leaders, acquisition teams, operational commanders, technical evaluators, and industry partners.
  • Own the strategy and execution for major European defense, aerospace, autonomy, and security events, prioritizing high-value account engagement, executive meetings, and opportunity progression over brand presence alone.
  • Establish event and program plans that align with regional procurement cycles, defense modernization priorities, budget timing, acquisition pathways, and capture strategies.
  • Partner with regional Go-to-Market teams to create and execute targeted account-based events and programs that generate new pipeline, advance existing opportunities, and deepen executive relationships.
  • Build and lead a high-performing Europe field marketing team while remaining hands-on with agencies, vendors, contracts, logistics, event production, and program delivery.
  • Create repeatable regional planning, intake, measurement, and reporting processes that enable disciplined prioritization across markets, accounts, events, and campaigns.
  • Establish KPIs that reflect complex defense sales cycles, including account penetration, stakeholder engagement depth, executive meeting quality, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, opportunity acceleration, and program return on investment.
  • Ensure programs reflect Shield AI’s brand, strategic narrative, and market position while adapting messaging and experiences appropriately for local markets and audiences.
  • Bring creativity, structure, sound judgment, and adaptability to an evolving environment where new international capabilities are being built in real time.

Required Qualifications

  • 12 + years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, or integrated marketing roles.
  • Demonstrated success marketing into European government, defense, military, aerospace, national security, or complex public-sector accounts.
  • Strong understanding of European defense and government buying environments, including long sales cycles, multi-year programs, procurement processes, and multi-stakeholder acquisition decisions.
  • Experience developing and executing account-based marketing strategies within complex enterprise, government, or defense accounts.
  • Credibility engaging senior military leaders, government officials, defense program leaders, acquisition stakeholders, and executive-level industry partners.
  • Proven experience leading teams while also operating as a hands-on builder and operator.
  • Experience planning and delivering high-impact executive engagement programs, strategic customer events, trade shows, and integrated field campaigns.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Sales, Business Development, Capture, Growth, Communications, Product, and regional leadership teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple European markets, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Europe and periodically to Africa.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional European languages are a plus.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and structure is still being developed.
Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

The Field Marketing Manager, India will execute field marketing across India’s defense and government ecosystem. This role will drive account-based marketing programs, support strategic capture efforts, and contribute to measurable pipeline impact in close partnership with regional Sales, Business Development, and Capture teams.

This is a hands-on role in a high-growth environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable executing account strategies and field programs, thrives in complex government sales environments, and understands how to align marketing activities with long-cycle defense procurement processes.

The Field Marketing Manager, India will report to the Director of Field Marketing, Asia Pacific / Middle East.

What You'll Do

  • Execute field marketing programs across India’s defense, Ministry of Defence, Armed Forces, DRDO, and strategic aerospace accounts, aligned with regional Go-to-Market priorities.
  • Support the development and execution of account-based marketing strategies for priority India-based government and defense accounts, helping map buying centers and coordinate multi-touch engagement across events, executive briefings, targeted campaigns, and customer programs.
  • Develop a strong understanding of India’s defense procurement environment, acquisition cycles, and stakeholder landscape, using that knowledge to inform effective marketing programs.
  • Execute major India-based defense and aerospace events, prioritizing high-value account engagement, customer meetings, and opportunity progression over brand presence alone.
  • Plan and execute owned customer events, private briefings, roundtables, and targeted engagements in partnership with Sales and Capture teams.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Business Development to align marketing programs with local account plans, pipeline targets, and strategic business priorities.
  • Support ABM programs designed to generate new pipeline, deepen engagement within strategic accounts, and accelerate existing opportunities.
  • Own Salesforce campaign execution, including creating and managing Campaign IDs, ensuring proper campaign structure, tracking member status, and maintaining data integrity in partnership with Sales.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure accurate opportunity association, contact mapping, and required CRM field completion to support reliable pipeline reporting and attribution.
  • Build and execute programs within Marketo, including campaign flows, audience segmentation, nurture programs, and performance reporting.
  • Track and report field marketing performance against KPIs including account engagement, stakeholder engagement, campaign participation, opportunity influence, pipeline contribution, and deal acceleration.
  • Manage event and program logistics, agencies, vendors, and other external partners to ensure high-quality and efficient execution.
  • Bring structure, accountability, and operational rigor to field marketing execution within a fast-growing international aerospace and defense organization.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated marketing, or related marketing roles, preferably with exposure to government, aerospace, or defense markets in India.
  • Experience marketing into India-based government, defense, aerospace, or public sector organizations. Experience with Ministry of Defence, Armed Forces, DRDO, or related organizations is highly valuable.
  • Understanding of India’s defense procurement processes, long-cycle acquisition environments, and complex multi-stakeholder account structures.
  • Proven experience executing account-based marketing programs within complex enterprise, government, or strategic accounts.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, including campaign creation, Campaign ID management, opportunity alignment, reporting, and maintaining strong CRM hygiene.
  • Hands-on experience with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform, including campaign execution, segmentation, nurture programs, and performance tracking.
  • Experience executing trade shows, industry events, executive briefings, and owned customer programs, preferably within the India aerospace and defense market.
  • Ability to engage professionally with senior military leaders, government stakeholders, defense industry executives, and technical audiences.
  • Strong project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Sales, Business Development, Capture, and Global Marketing teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and processes.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams. Proficiency in Hindi or other regional Indian languages is a plus.

The Presales Field Solutions Engineer (FSE) will provide technical expertise and support to customers prior to the sale of the Shield AI V-BAT Aircraft. The FSE serves as a technical force multiplier for the Go To Market (GTM) team, providing expertise on Shield AI’s products and services to drive customer engagement, solution alignment, and successful deal capture. This role bridges the gap between our technology roadmap and our customers' operational needs.

What you'll do:

    • Lead technical capture efforts for European opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically sound, feasible, and aligned with Shield AI’s product roadmap. Capture efforts will focus on the V-BAT aircraft, but will require familiarity with the entire Shield AI Product suite.
    • Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, including customer engagements, pre-sales technical support, proposal contributions, and solution development.
    • Develop and execute technical strategies that result in high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals to maximize win probability.
    • Serve as the primary technical lead for GTM engagements in Europe, interfacing cross-functionally with BD, BD Operations , Engineering, Operations, Program Management, and Product Management to ensure customer needs are met.
    • Manage technical content for proposals, requests for information (RFIs), white papers, and capability briefs, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance.
    • Support BD and Account Executives by becoming a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Shield AI products, providing technical expertise in customer engagements, capability briefings, and solution discussions to drive successful sales outcomes.
    • Act as a liaison between BD and Engineering, ensuring that new customer requests are technically feasible and align with product capabilities, timelines, and roadmaps.
    • Contribute to the technical documentation repository, maintaining capability briefs, specifications, FAQs, and other sales collateral for internal and external use.
    • Provide training and mentorship to BD teams on technical aspects of Shield AI’s solutions, enabling them to articulate our value proposition confidently.
    • Support competitive analysis and market intelligence, ensuring the BD team remains informed on industry trends and competitor capabilities.
    • Support customer demonstrations through the shaping, planning, and execution phases as an on-site V-BAT SME.
    • Contribute to process improvement efforts, leveraging lessons learned from customer engagements to refine BD workflows and technical capture strategies.
    • Analyze the unique operational and environmental factors of the assigned region, producing high-impact white papers and briefs that inform the product roadmap and drive solutions aligned to customer mission needs.

Required qualifications:

    • 5+ years of experience in technical presales, business development, or solutions engineering, preferably in defense, aerospace, AI-driven technology, or U.S. Federal/International government environments.
    • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field.
    • Experience working with U.S. Federal or International government requirements.
    • Strong technical acumen in Aircraft, UAS, multispectral sensor systems, AI, autonomy, and defense technology (experience with V-BAT, Hivemind, and Vision Systems preferred).
    • Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for technical assessments and solution development.
    • Strong technical writing ability to author requests for information, abstracts, and quad charts.
    • Proven leadership experience in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
    • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling messaging for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
    • Track record of high performance, including a demonstrated work ethic, reliability as a teammate, kindness, and commitment to high standards.
    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, nontraditional defense contractor environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale proposals.
  • Strong technical background especially with Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UASs).
  • Demonstrated thorough understanding and knowledge of the military operations and the acquisition process.
  • 3+ years of experience in an presales/solutions engineering role
  • 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment

Shield AI is hiring a Field Solutions Engineer based in Madrid, Spain to support technical sales, customer engagements, demonstrations, and capture activities focused on advanced simulation, synthetic environments, image generation systems, and AI-enabled mission systems.

This role will support defense simulation, training, test, and evaluation customers across Europe, helping them understand how Shield AI and Aechelon capabilities can support training systems, next-generation synthetic battlespace environments, live-virtual-constructive ecosystems, and AI-enabled simulation use cases.

This role requires direct, hands-on experience with advanced defense simulation, training, and test environments. The ideal candidate should understand image generation systems, platform-in-a-box solutions, threat models, constructive entities, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and LVC architectures, and how these technologies integrate into complex distributed simulation ecosystems.

This is a simulation-first role. Autonomy experience is valuable where AI or autonomy is used to run synthetic agents, generate behaviors, drive adversary models, automate scenarios, or improve realism in simulated environments. Real-world autonomy experience is preferred, but the primary requirement is deep simulation domain expertise combined with strong customer-facing technical communication.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a customer-facing technical expert for Shield AI and Aechelon simulation, synthetic environment, and AI-enabled mission system capabilities across Europe.
  • Support customer discovery, technical briefings, demonstrations, technical interchange meetings, RFIs, RFPs, proposals, white papers, and capture activities.
  • Translate customer mission needs, training objectives, test requirements, CONOPs, and integration considerations into credible solution concepts.
  • Support engagements involving European, NATO, and allied defense simulation, training, test, and evaluation environments.
  • Explain image generation systems, synthetic environments, PAIBs, threat models, LVC architectures, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and AI-enabled synthetic agents to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.
  • Partner with Business Development, Capture, Product, Engineering, Customer Engagement, Program, and technical teams to represent customer requirements, risks, roadmap gaps, and field feedback.
  • Help customers evaluate how advanced simulation and synthetic environments can support operational training, mission rehearsal, test and evaluation, experimentation, force modernization, and AI/autonomy development.
  • Develop technical sales assets, including capability briefs, demo scripts, solution templates, FAQs, white papers, technical explainers, and customer-specific briefing materials.
  • Maintain product truth by ensuring customer-facing materials and discussions accurately reflect current capabilities, constraints, roadmap timing, and integration considerations.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, operational users, acquisition organizations, defense primes, systems integrators, and internal cross-functional partners

Required qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in modeling and simulation, training systems, test and evaluation, image generation systems, synthetic environments, defense software, aerospace systems, solutions engineering, systems engineering, field applications engineering, technical sales, or related technical customer-facing roles.
  • Direct hands-on experience with defense simulation, training, or test environments supporting military or government customers.
  • Practical experience with image generation systems, platform-in-a-box systems, synthetic environments, threat models, constructive entities, sensor simulation, scenario generation, or live-virtual-constructive environments.
  • Strong understanding of how simulation systems are used for operational training, mission rehearsal, experimentation, test and evaluation, and capability development.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements, proposal efforts, integration discussions, technical interchange meetings, or operational workshops.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements, mission needs, training objectives, and technical constraints into feasible solution concepts, requirements, demos, and product feedback.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical systems to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product, Engineering, Customer Engagement, Program teams, and technical SMEs.
  • Strong judgment in representing product capabilities, limitations, roadmap dependencies, and integration considerations to customers.
  • Ability to operate independently across complex international customer engagements while maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders.
  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout Europe and internationally for customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, and internal meetings.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting defense simulation, training, test, or experimentation customers in Spain, Europe, NATO, or allied markets.
  • Experience working with ministries of defense, armed forces, government laboratories, defense primes, systems integrators, training organizations, or test organizations.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish or another European language.
  • Experience with AI-enabled synthetic agents, computer-generated forces, adversary behavior models, automated scenario generation, or AI-driven entity behavior in simulated environments.
  • Real-world autonomy experience, including autonomous aircraft, unmanned systems, robotics, AI-enabled mission systems, or autonomy software.
  • Familiarity with LVC architectures, simulation interoperability, DIS/HLA, test infrastructure, training range integration, or distributed simulation environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, C++, Linux, APIs, SDKs, simulation tooling, visualization systems, autonomy software, robotics middleware, or technical prototyping.
  • Prior military, defense, aerospace, simulation, test, training, robotics, unmanned systems, or advanced software experience.
  • Experience supporting proposals, RFIs, RFPs, white papers, technical volumes, or complex international capture activities.

Why join Shield AI

  • Help build the defining defence technology company of this century.  
  • Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems.  
  • Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission-driven environment.  
  • Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships.  
  • Collaborate with exceptional teams solving some of the world’s most complex operational challenges.

Job Description:

In this role, you will own the flight control system for XBAT, with responsibility for delivering stable, predictable, and operationally robust performance across all phases of flight, including vertical takeoff, hover, transition out-bound, wing-borne flight, transition in-bound, and precision recovery.

What you'll do:

  • Design and deliver the flight control system across all phases of flight including control allocation strategies that manage actuator redundancy, saturation, and degraded operations.
  • Lead development of high-fidelity 6DOF simulation environments and ensure accurate pre-flight performance predictions
  • Define and execute the verification strategy, including linear analysis, Monte Carlo campaigns, disturbance/sensitivity/degraded operation testing, and HIL validation
  • Diagnose and resolve simulation-to-flight mismatches, including unidentified dynamics and modeling gaps
  • Support flight test operations, making risk-informed decisions and driving rapid iteration between flights
  • Integrate control systems with propulsion, aero, actuation, sensors, state estimation, and autonomy, ensuring the vehicle behaves predictably under real-world disturbances and uncertainties
  • Mentor and guide engineers while setting the technical standard for control system performance and rigor

Required qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in flight controls / GNC on real flight vehicles, with demonstrated ownership from design through flight test
  • Demonstrated experience with control allocation design and implementation for over-actuated systems with provisions for saturation and failure accommodation.
  • Strong background in:
  • Flight dynamics and 6DOF simulation
  • Control theory and nonlinear systems
  • Experience executing full V&V cycles, including pre-flight performance prediction, Monte Carlo analysis, flight readiness assessment, and post-flight analysis
  • Proficiency in C++, MATLAB/Simulink, and/or Python, with experience deploying real-time algorithms
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • VTOL or transition aircraft experience where control blending and allocation were critical to success
  • Autonomous systems or missile/UAV GNC background
  • Experience with flight safety, airworthiness, and mission assurance
  • Familiarity with:
  • Sensor and air data systems
  • Fault-tolerant or adaptive control
  • CI/CD pipelines and modern DevSecOps practices
  • Experience with HIL or integrated simulation/test environments and Linux-based development workflows (Git, etc.)
  • Experience operating in rapid development environments with tight iteration loops between simulation and test

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a highly capable Flight Test Instrumentation Engineer to support the development, integration, and execution of instrumentation systems for X-BAT, the world’s first autonomous VTOL jet aircraft. In this role, you will design, install, validate, and maintain data acquisition systems essential to aircraft-level testing, safety, and mission success. 
 
The Flight Test Instrumentation Engineer is responsible for ensuring high-quality, reliable data capture across propulsion, structural, avionics, and autonomy systems. This engineer works closely with Flight Test, Systems Engineering, Avionics, Autonomy, and Safety teams to ensure instrumentation supports rigorous test objectives and enables rapid, data-driven iteration. 
 
This is a hands-on, field-focused role that requires strong technical depth, disciplined execution, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic test environment. 

What you'll do:

  • Design, integrate, and maintain flight test instrumentation systems including sensors, data acquisition hardware, telemetry links, harnessing, and ground station interfaces. 
  • Develop instrumentation architecture, sensor selection plans, wiring diagrams, and installation documentation in accordance with engineering standards. 
  • Support installation and calibration of sensors such as strain gauges, accelerometers, pressure transducers, temperature sensors, current/voltage taps, and position measurement devices. 
  • Configure and validate data acquisition systems including signal conditioning, synchronization, sampling rates, and data integrity verification. 
  • Perform pre-flight and post-flight data checks, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and traceability of all captured data.  
  • Troubleshoot instrumentation issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions under tight test timelines.
  • Collaborate with Flight Test teams to define instrumentation requirements, test plans, and safety considerations. 
  • Manage instrumentation inventories, spares, tools, and calibration records 
  • Support field deployments, remote test campaigns, and static engine/hover test operations. 
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of instrumentation processes and documentation. 

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical field.  
  • 10-15+ years of experience in flight test instrumentation, data acquisition systems, or related hardware integration roles.  
  • Hands-on experience installing and configuring sensors, DAQs, wiring harnesses, and telemetry systems.  
  • Strong understanding of instrumentation standards, signal conditioning, sampling theory, and data synchronization.   
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, and system architectures.  
  • Proficiency with instrumentation tools and software (e.g., NI, Dewesoft, HBM, ICS, telemetry systems).  
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to operate in a fast-paced test environment.  
  • Excellent communication and documentation capabilities.  
  • Ability to support extended travel and remote test deployments as required. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with developmental aircraft, flight test environments, or experimental test programs. 
  • Familiarity with IRIG time standards, PCM, Ethernet-based DAQ systems, and avionics data buses (ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, CAN, Ethernet). 
  • Familiarity with Curtis Wright DAS Studio and IADS software. 
  • Experience applying strain gauges, thermal instrumentation, or structural measurement sensors. 
  • Background in propulsion or structural testing, including engine run and hover test instrumentation. 
  • Experience with environmental sealing, harness fabrication standards, and EMI/EMC considerations. 
  • Master’s degree or higher in a related technical discipline.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an International Tax Manager to join its growing Tax team. This role is ideal for a tax professional who wants to go beyond recurring compliance execution and take meaningful ownership of international direct tax, planning support, special projects, and cross-functional business partnership. 

In a lean, fast-moving environment, you will help the company navigate the tax implications of global operations, new legal-entity structures, product and market expansion, and other strategic initiatives. You will also provide hands-on support for U.S. indirect tax matters, including sales and use tax compliance, controversy, process improvement, and automation opportunities. 

You will work closely with Tax, Accounting, FP&A, Legal, operational teams, and external advisors to translate complex tax issues into practical business guidance. This is a high-impact opportunity to help strengthen and scale a global tax function as the company grows. 

What you'll do:

    • Lead and support international direct-tax workstreams related to global operations, including U.S. international tax compliance, foreign tax reporting, and coordination with local-country advisors. 

    • Evaluate tax considerations associated with international expansion, new legal-entity structures, intercompany arrangements, evolving products, and other strategic business initiatives. 

    • Support tax planning, modeling, research, and implementation activities, including identifying risks, documenting technical positions, and assisting with execution of approved strategies. 

    • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Treasury, operational teams, and external tax advisors to deliver timely, practical, and business-oriented tax guidance. 

    • Support the tax provision process and related financial-reporting requirements, including documentation and analysis under ASC 740, as applicable. 

    • Monitor changes in U.S. and international tax laws, regulations, and administrative guidance; assess potential impacts and communicate actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 

    • Manage priority tax projects while balancing recurring operational responsibilities, deadlines, and evolving business needs. 

    • Help design, document, and improve tax processes, controls, data flows, and reporting capabilities as the company scales globally. 

    • Serve as a key internal resource for U.S. indirect tax matters, including sales and use tax, property tax, and other state and local indirect-tax obligations, as needed. 

    • Oversee or coordinate the preparation, review, and timely filing of applicable U.S. indirect-tax returns, working with internal stakeholders and external service providers. 

    • Support indirect-tax registrations, nexus assessments, exemption-certificate processes, taxability analyses, and related compliance requirements. 

    • Identify opportunities to improve indirect-tax compliance through automation, process standardization, data quality improvements, and stronger documentation. 

    • Assist with responses to state and local tax notices, audits, inquiries, and other tax controversy matters; coordinate with advisors and internal stakeholders to support favorable and timely resolution. 

    • Build strong cross-functional relationships and help the Tax team respond quickly, thoughtfully, and accurately to complex and high-priority matters. 

What you'll bring (Qualifications):

    • 5-8+ years of relevant corporate tax experience, including meaningful experience in international direct tax. 

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, or a related field; CPA is preferred. 

    • Strong knowledge of U.S. international tax concepts and compliance requirements 

    • Experience working with multinational organizations, international legal entities, foreign affiliates, or cross-border business arrangements. 

    • Working knowledge of U.S. state and local indirect tax, including sales and use tax; experience with property tax, excise tax, or other indirect-tax areas is a plus. 

    • Experience supporting tax provision, financial-reporting, and ASC 740 matters is preferred. 

    • Demonstrated ability to manage tax research, planning support, special projects, process improvements, or strategic initiatives in addition to recurring tax compliance. 

    • Experience partnering effectively with external tax advisors and managing deliverables, timelines, and technical workstreams. 

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly and pragmatically to non-tax stakeholders. 

    • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort operating in a lean, evolving, high-growth environment.

  • Operationally sharp — you turn messy input into fast, high quality decisions
  • Mission driven — motivated by work with real stakes and real impact

  • Rigorous yet pragmatic — you balance precision with speed and know when each matter
