Shield AI builds intelligent systems that protect service members and civilians. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software and aircraft systems, and our teams support customers and operations across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. 

Shield AI is seeking a senior, hands-on UxS Integration and Systems Expert to help ensure Hivemind can be developed, tested, demonstrated, and supported on representative unmanned systems with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of autonomy software, unmanned aircraft and robotic systems, onboard compute, networking, radios, sensors, flight controllers, simulation, test operations, and customer-facing demonstrations. 

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who is both a builder and an operator. The right candidate can move comfortably from architecture discussions to benchtop integration, from lab troubleshooting to field execution, and from platform evaluation to clear recommendations for engineering, test, product, and operations leaders. 

You will serve as a trusted systems-integration authority for Hivemind test and demonstration hardware. You will help teams select and prepare representative platforms, understand integration tradeoffs, improve test readiness, diagnose cross-disciplinary issues, and translate lessons from real hardware into better engineering, test, and operational practice. The role requires strong judgment, calm execution under pressure, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous technical environments without overfitting to a single platform or workflow. 

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a senior technical focal point for Hivemind integration and test readiness across unmanned aircraft, robotic systems, representative test vehicles, onboard compute, radios, sensors, payloads, and supporting ground equipment. 
  • Lead hands-on integration and troubleshooting efforts that span autonomy software, hardware, flight controllers, communications systems, networking, operator interfaces, and field operations. 
  • Partner with engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams to evaluate new platforms and determine how they can best support Hivemind development, validation, training, demonstrations, and customer objectives. 
  • Help take systems from early concept or benchtop integration through representative test, field execution, and operationally relevant demonstrations. 
  • Provide senior-level technical judgment on platform suitability, integration complexity, test readiness, risk, safety, maintainability, cost, availability, and customer value. 
  • Support test planning and execution across simulated, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, and flight-test environments while keeping the role focused on practical system readiness and evidence quality. 
  • Help define clear readiness criteria, test expectations, operating assumptions, and handoff points for representative hardware used by Hivemind teams. 
  • Diagnose complex cross-disciplinary issues and help route them effectively across software, autonomy, hardware, flight-test, networking, and operations stakeholders. 
  • Contribute to test methods, metrics, and evidence practices that improve confidence in Hivemind behavior across representative and real-world environments. 
  • Support automation, tooling, and data-review practices that improve repeatability, reduce manual burden, and make hardware-based testing easier to operate at scale. 
  • Capture and share practical knowledge from platform bring-up, test events, flight operations, and customer-facing demonstrations so teams can reuse lessons learned. 
  • Mentor engineers and operators on systems integration, hardware readiness, field troubleshooting, test discipline, and practical autonomy test execution. 

Projects you might work on:

  • Evaluating a new unmanned aircraft, ground robot, customer-selected platform, or lab setup for suitability as a Hivemind development, test, training, or demonstration asset. 
  • Leading technical preparation for a Hivemind test event or customer demonstration that depends on representative hardware, onboard compute, communications, sensors, and operator workflows. 
  • Advising a program team on the right level of platform fidelity needed for a pilot effort, internal test campaign, or customer-facing technical engagement. 
  • Supporting integration between Hivemind and flight-control systems, onboard compute, sensors, payloads, radios, ground-control equipment, or simulation environments. 
  • Helping a test team define practical readiness criteria, test coverage, data-review expectations, and evidence standards for hardware-based autonomy validation. 
  • Working with engineering and operations leaders to turn lessons from field or lab execution into reusable guidance, training, and better test practices. 

Required qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in UxS or UAS systems integration, robotics hardware integration, autonomy test operations, flight test, field engineering, embedded systems, or similar hands-on technical roles. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex integration efforts across hardware, software, autonomy, networking, communications, sensors, and operational test environments. 
  • Strong practical experience bringing up, configuring, operating, and troubleshooting unmanned systems, onboard compute, flight controllers, radios, sensors, ground stations, and supporting test equipment. 
  • Working knowledge of Linux, embedded systems, networking, system configuration, data collection, logs, services, and field diagnostics. 
  • Experience with unmanned-systems autopilot or flight-control ecosystems such as PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, Pixhawk/Cube-class flight controllers, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or equivalent systems. 
  • Experience supporting testing across simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, live-vehicle, field, or flight-test environments. 
  • Ability to develop and communicate test plans, readiness criteria, operating assumptions, technical recommendations, and post-test findings for cross-functional audiences. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills across ambiguous, cross-disciplinary technical issues. 
  • Ability to lead through influence across engineering, test, product, operations, field, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Familiarity with scripting, automation, or data-analysis workflows using Python, Bash, MATLAB, or similar tools. 
  • Strong ownership, urgency, and judgment in fast-moving environments where requirements, platforms, and constraints may evolve quickly. 
  • Ability to comply with export-control, safety, security, customer-site, and mission-specific operating requirements. 
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance; U.S. citizenship required. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Hivemind, autonomy SDKs, autonomous aircraft systems, robotics middleware, simulation infrastructure, or edge-deployed autonomy software. 
  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson, embedded Linux, systemd services, containerized deployment, device provisioning, and field update workflows. 
  • Experience with RF/radio setup, mesh networking, tactical datalinks, software-defined radios, or communications-degraded test scenarios. 
  • Experience supporting flight test, range operations, customer trials, operational rehearsals, or complex demonstrations. 
  • Experience integrating EO/IR cameras, gimbals, lidar, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, payloads, or perception sensors. 
  • Experience contributing to test automation, regression frameworks, data validation, performance benchmarking, or CI/CD-integrated test workflows. 
  • Familiarity with C++ for debugging, interface review, or collaboration with software engineering teams. 
  • FAA Part 107, private pilot license, military UAS, aviation maintenance, flight-test, or range-safety experience. 
  • Experience defining reference configurations, hardware baselines, supported configurations, or setup guidance for internal and external users. 
  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

Job Description:

 

This role is for a Computer Vision C++ Engineer to support the development of real-time perception capabilities for Shield AI's autonomous systems.

The Computer Vision Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and integrating advanced computer vision algorithms into high-performance C++ software pipelines. The role will focus on building custom perception capabilities from the ground up, with an emphasis on real-time performance, reliability, and deployment in edge compute environments. This position is required to increase the team's capacity and technical depth in real-time computer vision, image processing, and applied machine learning.

The successful candidate will bring strong C++ software engineering skills, experience developing high-performance or real-time systems, and a deep understanding of computer vision fundamentals. They should be capable of translating research concepts into deployable software and comfortable working on bespoke algorithms rather than relying only on existing libraries. Experience with areas such as visual SLAM, visual odometry, target tracking, feature detection and matching, 3D reconstruction, state estimation, sensor fusion, or real-time mapping would be highly valuable.

The role will also support the development of tracking and spatial perception pipelines for autonomous systems, including applications such as visual localization, motion estimation, scene reconstruction, landmark tracking, map building, and perception-assisted navigation. Familiarity with SLAM frameworks, probabilistic estimation, optimization, bundle adjustment, feature-based and direct methods, and deployment of real-time perception algorithms into C++ edge environments would be beneficial. Candidates with a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems, or a related field would be well aligned with the technical needs of the team, though strong applied industry experience is also highly relevant.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Deep proficiency in C++, with proven experience developing software in high-performance, real-time environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom computer vision algorithms from scratch, rather than exclusively applying existing libraries.
  • Solid foundational understanding of computer vision, image processing, and machine learning principles.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, performance optimization, and version control.
  • Proven ability to own technical work from ambiguous requirements through algorithm design, implementation, integration, and delivery.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary cross-functional teams, including AI experts, robotics engineers, and optical engineers, to deliver reliable edge solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

    We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out.
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with object detection, target tracking, 3D reconstruction, SLAM, camera calibration, or behaviour analysis.
  • Background in automated video surveillance or other related real-time vision systems.
  • Familiarity with industry-standard vision toolkits, such as OpenCV.
  • Exposure to deep learning methodologies for image classification, recognition, or sequence modelling.
  • Practical experience integrating deep learning models into broader computer vision systems for real-time deployment scenarios.
  • Previous experience in the Defence sector, autonomous unmanned systems, or similar mission-critical domains.

Job Description:
As a Senior Staff (L5) Environmental Control System (ECS) Engineer, you will take full technical ownership of the Environmental Control System architecture, analysis, design, and integration for a dedicated special access program. Serving as the sole ECS subject matter expert on this program, you will work from first principles to execute trades, size systems, design hardware, manage external suppliers, support proposals and capture, and deliver flight-ready hardware in a rapid-iteration development environment.  This position requires a balance of technical rigor, rapid decision-making, and hands-on engineering to efficiently transition concepts into operational capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable solving complex problems, taking ownership, working within an accelerated aircraft development environment, and is motivated by getting meaningful capability into the hands of operators quickly.

What you'll do:

  • Architecture and Trades: Lead ECS architecture definition and trade studies (e.g., vapor cycle vs. air cycle vs. passive/ram-air systems) to meet vehicle thermal, electrical, mass, and volume constraints.
  • Aerothermal and Circuit Design: Design and analyze vehicle air inlets, scoops, ducting networks, and ram-air cooling circuits to ensure adequate flow across flight envelopes.
  • Thermal and Fluid System Sizing: Perform first-principles thermodynamic and heat transfer hand calculations, backed by 1D fluid-thermal network modeling.
  • Component Sourcing and Vendor Management: Author technical specifications and statements of work (SOW) for ECS hardware (heat exchangers, fans, valves, compressors, sensors), evaluate vendors, and drive supplier technical execution.
  • Test and Validation: Define qualification and verification test plans, design test rigs, support instrumentation/DAQ setup, and execute test campaigns to validate performance against requirements.
  • Flight Test and Troubleshooting: Process flight-test thermal and fluid data to identify discrepancies, resolve anomalies via root-cause investigation, and implement rapid design changes.

Required qualifications:

  • Clearance required: US Citizens Only & Must have an Active Secret or higher clearance.
  • Experience: 8 to 15 years of direct experience in aerospace Environmental Control System and vehicle thermal/fluid system development.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Core Fundamentals: Deep mastery of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and heat transfer applied to aircraft or defense systems.
  • Modeling and Analysis: Demonstrated capability with 1D system modeling (e.g., Amesim, Flowmaster, or Python/MATLAB fluid networks) and ability to size systems from inlets to ram circuits to liquid cooling systems, air cooling systems, and more.
  • CAD and PLM: Experience in 3D CAD modeling, routing, and drawing release (Siemens NX preferred, or equivalent like CATIA/Creo) with PLM workflows.
  • Hardware and Supplier Execution: Proven track record sourcing COTS/custom aerospace components, driving suppliers to schedule, and assembling benchtop or vehicle-level test setups.
  • Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to self-direct, prioritize technical tasks without oversight, and deliver functional hardware under tight timelines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity with aerospace environmental requirements and test standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-HDBK-310, RTCA DO-160, SAE AIR/ARP standards).

Job Description:

We are seeking a Mission Engineer to own the mission representation of various programs, applying systems engineering, modeling, simulation, and operational analysis techniques to evaluate how Shield AI’s autonomous systems enable desired mission effects. This role is pivotal in analyzing mission architectures, system interactions, capability gaps, and performance drivers across multiple platforms and domains. You will work closely with engineering, product development, operational analysis, and defense stakeholders to translate mission needs into traceable autonomy requirements that inform design trade-offs, system requirements, technology priorities, and operational concepts. 

This position requires a strong understanding of military operations, systems engineering, modeling & simulation (M&S), mission analysis, operational analysis techniques, requirements traceability, and model verification and validation techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy and product development by connecting mission objectives and operational needs to system capabilities, architectures, and engineering decisions. 

What you'll do:

  • Employ the Mission Engineering process to develop pertinent analyses and assess how current and emerging autonomous capabilities enable  desired mission effects in representative military scenarios. 
  • Utilize systems engineering tools (e.g., Cameo, Sysml 2.0) alongside modeling and simulation tools (AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop mission models, architectures, analytical frameworks, requirements, and traceability artifacts. 
  • Development of Mission Engineering artifacts such as mission threads, concepts of operations (CONOPS), and mission architectures for new AI-driven autonomous capabilities. 
  • Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to translate mission needs and operational insights into system requirements, design decisions, and capability improvements. 
  • Define trade studies and sensitivity analyses to identify key mission drivers, capability gaps, system dependencies, and performance thresholds under varying operational conditions and threats. 
  • Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to characterize missions, define measures of effectiveness and performance, establish the data, modeling, and analysis required to assess them, and align system capabilities with operational needs.  
  • Develop and present technical reports, mission architectures, trade studies, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies. 
  • Leverage modern compute and development best practices (e.g., scalable cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing) to build, run, and iterate mission models and analysis pipelines quickly and reliably. 

Required qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in mission engineering, systems engineering, operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S) or a related discipline. 
  • Prior experience in mission-thread analysis, force-on-force analysis, capability-gap analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling. 
  • Proficiency with SysML or other systems engineering tools in conjunction with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, or Python for aerospace and defense applications. 
  • Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to characterize mission needs and translate operational objectives into system capabilities, requirements, and engineering trades. 
  • Demonstrated ability to apply systems engineering, modern compute, data analysis, and software development best practices to build and maintain reliable models, simulations, and analytical workflows. 
  • Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting technical and operational analyses to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities. 
  • Active Secret or Top-Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one). 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), digital engineering, and SysML 2.0. 
  • Familiarity with DoD Mission Engineering methodologies, systems-of-systems engineering, DoD acquisition processes and JCIDS. 
  • Experience integrating AI-driven decision-making algorithms or autonomous systems into mission engineering and operational analysis frameworks. 
  • Prior military service or experience working with U.S. Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Army, or Special Operations Forces.

Externally, it becomes the reference architecture deployed into customer environments, spanning commercial cloud, on-premise infrastructure, sovereign deployments, and fully air-gapped systems.

Evaluate and integrate orchestration, scheduling, and resource management technologies to maximize scalability and developer productivity.
  • Compute Platform: Design and optimize shared GPU infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. Improve resource utilization, scheduling efficiency, storage, networking, observability, and overall platform reliability.
  • Data & Model Lifecycle: Build platform capabilities that enable dataset management, experiment tracking, artifact management, model versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement.
  • Platform Distribution: Develop repeatable deployment and lifecycle management solutions using Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices. Support commercial cloud, customer-managed infrastructure, sovereign environments, and fully air-gapped deployments.
  • Technology Leadership: Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and establish architectural patterns that balance scalability, performance, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, autonomy teams, infrastructure engineers, and product teams to ensure the platform evolves alongside customer needs and advances in AI.

  • Engineers move from idea to distributed training in hours instead of days.
  • High GPU utilization through efficient scheduling with KAI on Kubernetes.
  • Researchers use modern AI tooling without unnecessary platform friction.
  • AI Workspaces become the standard development environment across autonomy programs.

  • The AI Factory Reference Architecture can be deployed consistently across cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped environments.

  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure projects.

    The AI Factory is the foundation for how Shield AI develops and deploys autonomy.

Your work will directly impact how quickly researchers can iterate, how efficiently compute resources are utilized, and how AI systems move from experimentation to operational deployment.

    This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of modern AI, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and defense, building a platform that enables the next generation of autonomy systems while leveraging the best of the open-source AI ecosystem.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes.

At Shield AI, we are building intelligent autonomous aircraft designed to operate and survive in highly contested environments. We are seeking a Survivability Materials Engineer to lead the selection, qualification, specification, and production implementation of low-observable and signature-control materials for next-generation autonomous aircraft.


This role is ideal for an engineer with experience in radar-absorbing materials, specialty coatings, electromagnetic material characterization, and aerospace manufacturing processes. You will work across survivability analysis, design engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and sustainment teams to ensure material solutions meet signature-performance requirements while remaining producible, inspectable, durable, and supportable throughout the aircraft lifecycle.

What you'll do:

  • Conduct material surveys and evaluate radar-absorbing materials, conductive materials, dielectric materials, specialty coatings, adhesives, sealants, and other survivability-related material systems.
  • Develop and maintain a survivability materials database containing performance, cost, supplier, part-number, availability, application, and sustainment information.
  • Partner with survivability analysis, design, manufacturing, and program teams to down-select materials based on signature performance, durability, producibility, weight, cost, and supply-chain risk.
  •  Develop material qualification plans and oversee electromagnetic, electrical, mechanical, thermal, chemical, and environmental testing.
  • Establish and maintain laboratory capabilities for material characterization, process development, receiving inspection, and production verification.
  • Provide hands-on production support for material application, inspection, troubleshooting, repair, supplier coordination, and sustainment.

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. or M.S. in Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in aerospace materials engineering, low-observable materials, electromagnetic materials, specialty coatings, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of radar-absorbing materials, conductive coatings, dielectric materials, adhesives, sealants, or specialty surface treatments.
  • Understanding of how complex permittivity, complex permeability, conductivity, and thickness affect electromagnetic and radar-signature performance.
  • Experience with material characterization, laboratory testing, production inspection, or supplier qualification.
  • U.S. Citizenship and active Secret clearance required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience developing or qualifying radar-absorbing materials, low-observable coatings, structural RAM, conductive treatments, or signature-control appliqués.
  • Experience measuring electromagnetic material properties using free-space, waveguide, coaxial, resonant-cavity, or reflectivity-based test methods.
  • Familiarity with vector network analyzers, free-space measurement systems, conductivity equipment, coating-thickness instruments, environmental chambers, and mechanical test equipment.
  •  Active Secret, Top Secret, or SCI security clearance.

You will join the Systems Engineering, Integration, & Test (SEIT) team in the Hivemind Enterprise organization.

This ecosystem combines developer tools, APIs, data infrastructure, simulation, AI/ML workflows, and GenAI-enabled automation to accelerate the delivery of autonomous capabilities using Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, world models, foundation models, and other applied AI technologies.

As the responsible architect, you will define the comprehensive architecture for this product area, maintain architectural integrity across development teams, and ensure the ecosystem can operate across enterprise cloud, high-performance computing, and secure or disconnected deployment environments. What you'll do:

  • Own and evolve the architecture of the Hivemind Forge AI development ecosystem.
  • Define and maintain architecture products in an integrated model-based systems engineering (MBSE) environment, connecting architectural intent to engineering execution.
  • Establish architectural patterns, interfaces, APIs, SDK concepts, and technical standards across software, AI/ML, data, simulation, and deployment capabilities.
  • Define the data and metadata architecture underpinning the AI development lifecycle, including schemas, relationships, lineage, provenance, versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure traceable pedigree across datasets, training configurations, model artifacts, evaluations, software versions, and deployed capabilities to support reproducibility and auditability.
  • Architect GenAI-enabled and agentic development workflows that accelerate data curation, autonomy development, experimentation, evaluation, troubleshooting, and deployment while preserving human oversight, security, verification, and traceability.
  • Define architectural patterns for integrating AI coding assistants, agents, foundation models, and natural-language interfaces with Hivemind development tools, APIs, SDKs, data, simulation, and engineering workflows.
  • Define architecture for scalable AI/ML workloads across cloud, high-performance compute (HPC), and on-premises infrastructure, including orchestration, workload scheduling, containerization, storage, and data movement.
  • Ensure the ecosystem can be deployed and operated in classified, air-gapped, disconnected, and other constrained enterprise environments while preserving security, configuration control, and reproducibility.
  • Ensure AI-assisted and agentic development workflows preserve appropriate provenance, traceability, human oversight, verification, security, and reproducibility, particularly when contributing to deployed autonomous capabilities.
  • Guide architecture for workflows spanning data ingestion and curation, synthetic data generation, model training and tuning, evaluation, optimization, validation, and deployment.
  • Review and approve detailed software and data designs, resolve cross-team architectural issues, and maintain architectural integrity through implementation and integration.
  • Partner with software, AI/ML, data, systems, product, and technical leadership teams to reduce the time from mission need to validated, deployable autonomy.

Required qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in software or software-intensive systems development, design, and/or architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting complex software platforms, developer ecosystems, SDKs, APIs, AI/ML platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Experience developing AI/ML solutions using synthetic and real-world data.
  • Experience in data modeling and data architecture, including metadata, lineage, provenance, versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of how data, training configurations, model artifacts, evaluations, software, and deployments must be connected to provide end-to-end traceability, reproducibility, and auditability.
  • Experience applying Generative AI, AI assistants, or agents to software, AI/ML, or engineering development workflows.
  • Practical understanding of technologies such as Kubernetes, Slurm or comparable workload schedulers, containerization, infrastructure as code, and object/data storage platforms such as S3-compatible systems.
  • Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide detailed design and maintain alignment across multiple engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing AI-native or agentic workflows, including tool use, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Experience with MLOps, distributed training, simulation, synthetic data generation, experiment tracking, or model registries.
  • Direct experience developing, training, tuning, evaluating, applying, or deploying VLMs, VLAs, world models, foundation models, or related modern AI models.
  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating software and AI/ML platforms in classified, air-gapped, disconnected, or restricted-network environments.
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, on-premises, or edge deployment architectures.
  • Experience architecting autonomy, robotics, aerospace, unmanned systems, or other Physical AI applications.
  • Experience applying MBSE methods and tools, including SysML and Cameo/MagicDraw.
  • Experience delivering defense, aerospace, safety-relevant, or other high-assurance systems requiring rigorous configuration management, verification, and traceability.

Impact;

    You will establish the architectural foundation that enables Hivemind users to transform mission needs, data, AI models, and software into deployable autonomous capabilities—faster, repeatedly, and with confidence in how each capability was created, evaluated, and validated.

You will serve as the focal point for all technical matters related to thrust vectoring, ensuring the system enables precise flight control authority, integrates cleanly with the engine and airframe, and performs reliably across the full range of operational conditions.   • Represent the TVC system in design reviews, technical checkpoints, customer briefings, and leadership updates.

  • Demonstrated experience in hardware development, test planning, and flight test support.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for performance analysis, data processing, and model correlation.
  • Familiarity with tools such as ANSYS, FEA, or thermal/fluid modeling for mechanism and system validation.

  • Experience collaborating on control logic development, transient response shaping, and actuator tuning.
  • Proficiency with Siemens NX and Teamcenter for CAD and configuration control.
  • Background in failure modes analysis, margin modeling, and system validation strategies.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

Job Description:

We are growing the Avionics Engineering team to support the development, integration, test, production, and field support of flight-critical aircraft systems. Our team is responsible for avionics hardware and electrical systems that support communications, compute, autonomy, power, telemetry, sensors, and other mission-critical aircraft functions.

You will directly supervise a team of professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting integration, testing, debugging. This role is both a hands-on technical leadership position and a people leadership position. You will execute assignments based on defined objectives and established processes while providing guidance, mentorship, and daily direction to the technician team.

You will work closely with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and cross-functional peers to ensure avionics hardware is built, tested, debugged, documented, and supported safely and effectively. This role requires the ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.

The ideal candidate is a technically credible leader who can guide a team through complex, high-consequence avionics work; embed training into daily execution; analyze data and relevant factors; exercise sound judgment; interpret policies and procedures.

What you'll do:

  • Directly supervise professional and skilled engineering technicians supporting avionics system testing, integration, debugging, production support, maintenance support, and flight support activities.
  • Execute team assignments based on defined objectives, approved processes, engineering direction, production priorities, and program schedules.
  • Read, interpret, and apply harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, interface control documents, engineering drawings, test procedures, work instructions, and production documentation.
  • Support avionics integration and test activities from bench-level checkout through subsystem, aircraft, production, maintenance, and flight-support environments.
  • Work closely with engineers to support hardware bring-up, design verification, test execution, root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and design or process improvements.
  • Partner with production teams to resolve build issues, installation problems, test failures, rework needs, hardware readiness concerns, and schedule constraints.
  • Collaborate with quality teams to ensure work complies with inspection requirements, workmanship standards, configuration control expectations, nonconformance processes, and approved procedures.
  • Coordinate with supply chain teams to communicate material shortages, suspect hardware, part replacement needs, supplier issues, and impacts to build, test, or flight-readiness schedules.
  • Support maintenance technicians and flight support team members during aircraft checkout, avionics troubleshooting, system modification, ground test, and flight readiness activities.
  • Administer company policies and procedures directly affecting employees, including expectations related to safety, quality, attendance, work assignments, training, performance, compliance, and conduct.
  • Interpret policies, procedures, and work instructions to determine appropriate action when resolving routine employee, operational, quality, or technical execution issues.
  • Analyze data and relevant factors, including test results, failure trends, technician workload, schedule performance, hardware status, quality findings, material availability, and operational risks.
  • Develop, manage, and adjust routine operational plans to support daily priorities, weekly execution, production needs, integration milestones, maintenance activities, flight support, and monthly targets.
  • Use and oversee use of electrical and avionics test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, breakout boxes, bus analyzers, automated test equipment, and related lab or production tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement in technician training, troubleshooting methods, test procedures, documentation quality, tooling, workflow, and operational execution.

Required qualifications:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with avionics systems, aircraft electrical systems, electronics, harnesses, PCBAs, integrated test environments, or complex hardware systems.
  • 2+ years of experience directly supervising, leading, training, or coordinating skilled technicians in an engineering, production, test, aerospace, aviation, maintenance, or advanced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret harness schematics, PCBA schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, test procedures, and work instructions.
  • Experience performing avionics or electrical troubleshooting across wiring, connectors, PCBAs, power systems, sensors, communication interfaces, test equipment, and integrated systems.
  • Experience using electrical and avionics test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, analyzers, breakout boxes, and automated test systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and training to technicians during hands-on technical work.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute assignments based on defined objectives, established processes, schedule priorities, and operational targets.
  • Experience administering workplace policies, reinforcing safety and quality standards, and supporting employee performance expectations.
  • Ability to analyze technical data, test results, operational constraints, schedule risks, quality findings, and resource availability to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing work, assigning resources, escalating risks, and making decisions within defined objectives and processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, production, quality, supply chain, maintenance technicians, flight support team members, subordinate supervisors, and functional peers.

The Systems Engineer, Autonomy & Software at Shield AI is responsible for solving complex systems engineering challenges associated with the development, integration, and deployment of advanced autonomous systems for defense applications.

This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software engineering, and autonomy. The Systems Engineer works across multidisciplinary engineering teams to translate mission and customer needs into system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies while maintaining a deep technical understanding of the software and autonomy capabilities being delivered.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in software and autonomy, is comfortable developing and debugging software in C++ and Python, and has significant experience applying systems engineering principles within complex defense programs. They should be equally comfortable working at the system level and diving into technical implementation when required.

What you’ll do

  • Apply systems engineering principles to the development and integration of autonomous systems for defense applications.
  • Translate operational needs, mission objectives, and customer requirements into clear system, subsystem, software, and autonomy requirements.
  • Develop and maintain system architectures, functional decompositions, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, requirements traceability, and verification strategies.
  • Work closely with autonomy, software, guidance, navigation and control, avionics, hardware, test, and platform engineering teams to ensure successful system integration.
  • Define and manage interfaces between Hivemind Autonomy, vehicle systems, mission systems, sensors, communications, payloads, and external systems.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying autonomy and software architecture, including how system level requirements translate into software behavior and implementation.
  • Develop software, prototypes, analysis tools, test infrastructure, and engineering utilities using C++ and Python when required to solve integration and system level engineering problems.
  • Use code, simulation, logs, telemetry, and other engineering data to investigate system behavior, diagnose failures, validate assumptions, and support technical decision making.
  • Lead and support system integration activities across simulation, software in the loop, hardware in the loop, ground test, and flight test environments.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, or delivering complex software intensive systems, preferably within aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems.
  • Strong software engineering background with hands on experience developing and debugging software in C++ and Python.
  • Experience with autonomous or robotic systems, including familiarity with areas such as perception, planning, estimation, guidance, navigation, controls, or mission autonomy.
  • Strong understanding of systems engineering principles and their application to complex defense systems.
  • Experience developing and managing system and subsystem requirements, including requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification.
  • Experience developing system architectures, functional architectures, interface definitions, Interface Control Documents, and other system level engineering artifacts.

Job Description:
As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.
 
This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.
 
Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
  • Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
  • Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
  • Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
  • Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
  • Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
  • Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
  • Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
  • Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
  • Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
  • Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
  • Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
  • Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight
  • Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
  • Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
  • Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
  • Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

Job Description:

The Demonstration Team - Senior Associate Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) is responsible for planning, executing, and leading domestic and international unmanned aircraft operations in support of customer demonstrations, evaluations, training events, operational exercises, and business development activities. 

This position serves as one of the primary customer-facing representatives of the company and plays a critical role in showcasing the capabilities of the V-BAT system to military, government, and commercial customers worldwide. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate exceptional aviation judgment, professionalism, technical expertise, and adaptability while operating in dynamic and often austere environments. 

Unlike traditional flight operations, Demonstration Team AVOs are expected to independently execute missions with limited support while simultaneously serving as operators, instructors, maintainers, mission planners, technical advisors, and customer liaisons. Success in this role requires the ability to rapidly solve complex technical and operational problems while maintaining a relentless commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. 

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys frequent travel, embraces uncertainty, and is motivated by building customer confidence through exceptional operational execution. 

What you'll do:

  • Customer-Focused Flight Operations- Safely executes complex demonstrations while building customer confidence through professional, disciplined, and mission-focused flight operations.
  • Mission Planning & Operational Leadership- Plans and leads all aspects of flight operations including risk management, airspace coordination, contingency planning, crew coordination, and mission execution.
  • Technical Troubleshooting & Systems Knowledge- Rapidly identifies, diagnoses, and resolves aircraft, payload, datalink, and ground system issues to maximize mission success and aircraft availability.
  • Instruction, Mentorship & Team Development- Develops customers and teammates through classroom instruction, simulator training, live-flight instruction, mentorship, and standardization.
  • Adaptability & Independent Decision-Making- Thrives in rapidly changing domestic and international environments by exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and maintaining operational effectiveness under pressure. 

Required Qualifications:

    • Minimum 1,000 documented unmanned flight hours or 250 manned flight hours   

    • Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate  

    • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret DoD Security Clearance  

    • Ability to pass required background investigations, drug screenings, and customer medical/dental requirements  

    • Willingness and ability to travel 60–75%, including frequent CONUS and OCONUS deployments  

    • Demonstrated experience operating independently in dynamic, high-tempo, and austere environments  

    • Strong aviation decision-making, operational risk management, and safety mindset  

    • Excellent verbal communication and professional customer engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications:

    • FAA Private Pilot Certificate (PPL) or FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

    • FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot Certificate  

    • Previous instructor qualification in manned or unmanned aviation  

    • Prior military aviation or UAS operational experience  

    • Experience supporting DoD, allied, or international military operations  

    • Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

    • Experience leading customer demonstrations, operational evaluations, or flight operations  

    • Experience troubleshooting aircraft, payload, datalink, or ground control systems 

    • Familiarity with ISR payloads, SATCOM, BVLOS operations, and tactical communications  

    • Experience coordinating international deployments, logistics, or expeditionary operations

They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence.

Job Description:

A Senior Associate V-BAT Operator, AVO, assigned to Field Integration and Test (FIT), supports V-BAT field integration activities and flight operations in CONUS and OCONUS environments. This role supports customer site surveys, system installations, calibration events, aircraft operational checks, training support, and operational handoff activities in coordination with Engineering and Customer Operations teams. 

This position extends beyond traditional AVO duties. FIT AVOs support site survey planning and execution, installation readiness, aircraft and ground system setup, calibration support, and post-calibration operational checks. After calibration activities, the FIT AVO works with Deployment Operations to verify aircraft readiness, confirm operational usability and set deployed operators up for successful customer operations. 

FIT AVOs support DoD, coalition, and international customers in maritime and land-based environments. This includes austere, high-tempo, shipboard, expeditionary, and customer test environments. Senior Associates are expected to model professionalism, enforce safety standards, mentor junior operators, and contribute to system readiness, customer confidence, and mission success. 

FIT AVOs may also provide cross-functional support within Customer Operations and support Production Flight Test, Experimental Flight Test, and demonstration activities as required and when team bandwidth permits.

What you'll do:

    • Field integration support: Supports site surveys, installations, calibrations, aircraft operational checks, and customer handoff activities while maintaining safe and effective V-BAT operations 

    • Operational leadership: Leads flight operations and field events with autonomy, sound judgment, and disciplined risk management 

    • Systems troubleshooting: Diagnoses and resolves issues across aircraft, payloads, ground systems, datalinks, LAN-based networks, MANET networks, RF communications, SATCOM, and support equipment in field conditions 

    • Cross-functional coordination: Works directly with FIT, Deployment Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Training, Customer Operations, and customers to close issues and drive operational readiness 

    • Instructor and mentorship capability: Trains, evaluates, and develops operators while reinforcing standards, TTPs, checklist discipline, and safe operating practices 

Required Qualifications:

    • Demonstrated instructor experience (manned or unmanned aviation)  

    • FAA Private Pilot License (PPL)  

    • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate  

    • Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate  

    • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret DoD security clearance  

    • Ability to pass background check, drug screening, and customer-required medical/dental screenings  

    • Willingness to travel on short notice 50 to 75 percent in support of CONUS and OCONUS site surveys, installs, calibrations, flight operations, customer events, and deployment support 

    • Ability to climb ship masts, vertical ladders, and rooftop access points; work in confined or tight areas; and lift and carry 50 pounds or more in land-based and maritime environments 

    • Proven ability to lead and operate independently in small teams, including austere, shipboard, expeditionary, and high-tempo environments 

    • Strong aviation judgment, decision-making, crew coordination, and risk management skills 

    • Ability to troubleshoot aircraft, payload, ground control, communications, network, and support equipment issues at the field level 

Preferred Qualifications:

    • FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot License  

    • Experience operating as aircrew on manned aircraft  

    • Experience with MANET, MPU5, RF communications, Starlink, Starshield, and SATCOM integration or setup 

    • Prior military service, especially with overseas, maritime, or deployed operations 

    • Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience 

    • Previous experience as a Site Lead, Crew Lead, Instructor Operator, or aviation operations lead 

    • Experience supporting system installation, calibration, test events, or field acceptance activities 

    • Experience troubleshooting RF, C2, SATCOM, MANET, Starlink, Starshield, ISR payload, or ground control system issues

Job Description:

Do you enjoy working in a dynamic lab environment and contributing to hardware that can directly impact the safety of service members and civilians? Shield AI is looking for a hands-on Vibration Test Engineer to help validate the next generation of intelligent autonomous systems through rigorous dynamic testing.

The Mechanical Test team's mission is to inform and improve Shield AI hardware design by quantifying product performance through custom measurement systems, specialized testing, and rigorous analysis. As a Vibration Test Engineer, you will serve as the team's subject matter expert in vibration and structural dynamics, leading efforts to characterize hardware response, validate analytical models, and ensure products can withstand demanding operational environments.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about structural dynamics, curious about how complex systems behave under dynamic loading, and excited to solve challenging engineering problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You will partner closely with Mechanical Design, Analysis, Flight Test, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to develop test strategies, investigate failures, and improve hardware performance throughout the product lifecycle.

Success in this role requires deep technical expertise in vibration testing, strong analytical thinking, exceptional organization, and the ability to communicate complex technical findings to cross-functional engineering teams.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and analysis of vibration test programs supporting product development, qualification, and flight readiness.
  • Design, build, and deploy instrumented test setups for vibration, modal, structural, and environmental testing using industry-standard measurement equipment.
  • Execute shaker table testing including sine sweep, random vibration, sine-on-random, resonance search, dwell, and shock testing.
  • Perform experimental modal analysis to characterize structural dynamics and validate finite element models.
  • Develop fixture designs and test methodologies that accurately replicate operational loading conditions while minimizing fixture influence.
  • Instrument hardware using accelerometers, strain gauges, force sensors, displacement sensors, and other dynamic measurement systems.
  • Analyze vibration response data using frequency-domain and time-domain techniques to identify resonances, mode shapes, damping characteristics, and potential failure mechanisms.
  • Partner closely with Mechanical Design and Structural Analysis engineers to correlate test results with analytical models and improve future designs.
  • Investigate vibration-related hardware issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend design improvements.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, procedures, reports, and technical presentations that clearly communicate results and engineering recommendations.
  • Maintain vibration testing equipment, data acquisition systems, instrumentation, and calibration records.
  • Support environmental qualification testing and other mechanical test activities as needed.

Required qualifications:

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience performing vibration testing of mechanical or aerospace systems through industry, research, internships, or competitive engineering projects.
  • Experience operating electrodynamic shaker systems and associated vibration control software.
  • Experience with accelerometers, signal conditioning, data acquisition systems, and dynamic instrumentation.
  • Working knowledge of structural dynamics, vibration theory, modal analysis, and frequency response functions.
  • Experience performing or supporting experimental modal testing and finite element model correlation.
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-810 vibration and shock testing or equivalent aerospace qualification standards.
  • Experience interpreting vibration data and identifying resonances, structural response characteristics, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of CAD software (NX preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical work, drive projects independently, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced engineering environment.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret//Special Access Required (S//SAR) security clearance is desired.

Preferred qualifications:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field with an emphasis in structural dynamics or vibration.
  • Experience designing vibration test fixtures and specialized dynamic test equipment.
  • Experience using vibration control and data acquisition platforms such as Data Physics, Brüel & Kjær (HBK), Crystal Instruments, m+p International, LMS/Simcenter Testlab, or similar systems.
  • Experience with finite element analysis software (ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran, or equivalent) and test-analysis correlation.
  • Experience with strain gauge testing, digital image correlation (DIC), or other advanced structural measurement techniques.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, robotics, UAV, or other high-reliability hardware development programs.
  • Experience with Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, and failure investigation.

Shield AI is seeking a Senior / Staff C++ Software Engineer, Edge Systems to help define and build the software foundations that power autonomous systems operating in demanding real-world environments. 

This role sits within the Edge Systems team, where software meets hardware. You'll solve complex engineering problems spanning Linux edge computing, imaging, sensor integration, mission systems, and autonomy, building software that runs on real hardware in operational environments rather than laboratory prototypes. 

As one of our senior technical contributors, you'll combine hands-on software engineering with technical ownership. You'll influence architecture, mentor engineers, guide technical direction, and help shape the long-term evolution of our edge software platform while remaining close to implementation. 

You will develop modern C++ applications for Linux-based edge compute platforms, including NVIDIA Jetson-class systems, ARM64, and Windows systems. Your work will span sensor integration, imaging pipelines, calibration, diagnostics, deployment, developer tooling, and mission-critical applications that demand high performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

This is an application and systems software role, focused on Linux-based edge computing rather than bare-metal firmware or microcontroller development. 

No two weeks look the same. One day you might be optimising image-processing pipelines on embedded GPUs. The next you could be designing software architecture for future autonomous platforms, integrating new sensors, or collaborating with AI researchers to bring new capabilities into production. 

You'll work alongside highly capable systems, hardware, autonomy, AI, product, and test engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems together. We believe our strongest technical leaders remain hands-on, and we expect our Staff Engineers to continue writing software while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them. 

This position may be hired at Senior or Staff Engineer level depending on experience. Responsibilities and scope will be aligned to the successful candidate. 

What you'll do:

    Technical Leadership

    • Lead the technical direction of significant edge software capabilities spanning edge compute, imaging, sensor integration, and mission systems. 

    • Influence software architecture across multiple projects and engineering teams. 

    • Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, technical standards, and pragmatic engineering practices. 

    • Mentor and coach engineers, helping raise the technical capability of the wider organisation. 

    • Partner with systems, autonomy, AI, and product teams to translate long-term capability into engineering roadmaps. 

    • Identify technical risks early and guide teams toward robust, maintainable solutions. 

    • Balance long-term architectural investment with practical product delivery. 

      • Software Engineering

      • Design, develop, test, and maintain production C++ software for edge systems, imaging systems, mission applications, developer tooling, and automated test infrastructure. 

      • Build user-space Windows and Linux applications for NVIDIA Jetson, ARM64, and other edge compute platforms connected to cameras, sensors, and mission systems. 

      • Integrate RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras alongside GPS, IMU, and other sensors using interfaces such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Ethernet, serial, or comparable hardware-facing protocols. 

      • Develop calibration, synchronisation, data capture, diagnostics, inspection, and configuration tools for complex sensor systems. 

      • Optimise software for latency, throughput, reliability, power consumption, and thermal performance on constrained edge compute platforms. 

      • Debug challenging issues spanning application software, Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, timing, deployment, and system integration. 

      • Own technical outcomes from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

      • Collaborate across systems, hardware, AI, autonomy, product, and test teams to deliver integrated capability. 

       

Required qualifications:

    • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 

    • Strong commercial experience developing modern C++ software for Linux. 

    • Demonstrated experience developing user-space applications that interface with cameras, sensors, networking, GPUs, storage, or other hardware through operating system APIs, middleware, or vendor SDKs. 

    • Practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux. 

    • Experience developing complex C++ applications on Linux, Windows, or both. Experience deploying software to Linux-based edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable ARM64 systems is highly regarded. 

    • Strong software engineering fundamentals including concurrency, interfaces, memory management, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. 

    • Proven ability to diagnose complex issues across software, Linux, networking, timing, hardware integration, and deployment boundaries. 

    • Experience owning technical work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, integration, verification, and delivery. 

    • Excellent collaboration skills across multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Preferred qualifications:

    We do not expect candidates to have all of the following. Experience in any of these areas will help you stand out. 

    • Runtime-critical, multi-threaded, or performance-sensitive C++ software. 

    • High-throughput imaging or sensor processing pipelines, including camera integration, ISP tuning, GStreamer, FFmpeg, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 

    • Hardware-accelerated processing on edge compute platforms including NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm Snapdragon, CUDA, GPU compute, embedded AI accelerators, or accelerated video processing. 

    • Integration of RGB, NIR, and thermal cameras, GPS, IMU, GPUs, or comparable peripheral hardware. 

    • Robotics, aerospace, defence, autonomy, unmanned systems, automotive, or other mission-critical domains. 

    • Systems architecture, interface design, software decomposition, reliability, maintainability, and testability. 

    • Low-level Linux, vendor SDKs, driver-adjacent debugging, NixOS, edge AI inference, containerisation, or deployment tooling. 

    • Automated testing, simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, CI/CD, or deployment infrastructure. 

Additional Experience for Staff Level Engineers:

    While we hire across multiple experience levels, successful Staff Engineer candidates will typically demonstrate several of the following: 

    • Experience defining architecture for large or technically complex software systems. 

    • A track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams or products. 

    • Proven technical leadership through influence rather than organisational authority. 

    • Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping grow engineering capability across an organisation. 

    • Ownership of long-term technical strategy alongside day-to-day software delivery. 

    • Strong judgement when balancing performance, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and delivery. 

    • Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or software platforms adopted by multiple teams.

You will integrate sensors, diagnose system behaviour, improve performance, and deliver reliable software as part of a multidisciplinary team, with scope and autonomy matched to your experience.

Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Staff Product Support to support the design, development, integration, and fielding of a next-generation autonomous aircraft system. This role will lead the logistics planning, supply support, sustainment analysis, and lifecycle support activities across development, flight test, production, and operational sustainment.

The ideal candidate has strong experience supporting military or defense aviation programs and understands how logistics products, supportability analysis, maintenance planning, and supply chain execution contribute to mission availability and operational readiness. This position requires hands-on experience with Maintenance Task Analysis, Logistics Control Numbers, Reliability and Maintainability artifacts, and Supply Support planning and execution.

What you'll do:

  • Lead logistics and sustainment planning activities for a UAS program across design, production, deployment, and field support phases.
  • Develop, manage, and maintain integrated logistics support products, including maintenance concepts, support equipment design, provisioning inputs, spares planning, and sustainment documentation.
  • Perform and manage Maintenance Task Analysis to define preventive and corrective maintenance requirements, task frequencies, required tools, support equipment, skill levels, labor hours, and maintenance levels.
  • Develop and maintain Logistics Control Number structures to support provisioning, maintenance planning, technical documentation, configuration tracking, and sustainment data management.
  • Partner with engineering, program management, manufacturing, supply chain, field operations, and customer stakeholders to ensure logistics requirements are incorporated into system design and program execution.
  • Support Reliability and Maintainability activities, including Level of Repair Analysis, FMECA data analysis, maintainability assessments, corrective action planning, reliability growth inputs, and operational availability improvement initiatives.
  • Lead supply support activities, including spares analysis, provisioning, parts forecasting, inventory planning, reorder recommendations, repair pipeline coordination, sustainment risk identification, and obsolescence management.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, depots, repair vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely availability of parts, support equipment, and logistics resources.
  • Support proposal development, basis of estimate inputs, staffing plans, sustainment strategies, and logistics cost estimates for new and existing UAS programs.
  • Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable defense standards, contract requirements, export control requirements, and company processes.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in logistics, engineering, supply chain, aviation maintenance, business, or a related field; equivalent military or defense logistics experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting UAS or fighter aircraft logistics and sustainment
  • Demonstrated experience with Maintenance Task Analysis and development of maintenance planning data.
  • Expertise of Logistics Control Number structures and their use in provisioning, maintenance planning, and supportability analysis.
  • Experience with Reliability and Maintainability principles, including failure modes, maintainability drivers, reliability growth, availability metrics, and field performance analysis, and LORA development
  • Hands-on supply support experience, including spares planning, provisioning, inventory management, parts forecasting, repairables management, and sustainment execution.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, bills of material, configuration data, maintenance data, and technical documentation.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, program management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, field service, and customer teams.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to lead logistics efforts in a fast-paced program environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proven experience with integrated product support elements, including product support management, supply support, support equipment, manpower and personnel, facilities, maintenance planning,
  • Experience with provisioning, sparing, or supportability tools such as PowerLOG-J, SLICwave, COMPASS, CASA, OPUS10, EAGLE, or similar systems.

Job Description:

The Sr. Manager, Enterprise Data is responsible for leading delivery across Shield AI’s Enterprise Data team as the organization enables business domains onto its governed Databricks data platform. 

This role manages the engineers and delivery work required to turn enterprise data strategy into usable, reliable data products. The Sr. Manager will establish effective delivery rhythms, guide domain prioritization, manage capacity and dependencies, and ensure that business needs are translated into clear, appropriately scoped work for the Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Domain Enablement, and Data Governance functions. 

The role requires substantial data and analytics depth to assess delivery approaches, challenge unclear requirements, make appropriate tradeoffs, and ensure that the team produces durable, governed, production-ready outcomes rather than one-off reporting solutions. 

The Sr. Manager partners closely with the Sr. Director of Enterprise Data & Architecture on strategy, operating model, investment priorities, executive engagement, and cross-functional alignment. The role partners with Platform Engineering and Enterprise Architecture, which remain direct functions of the Sr. Director, to ensure domain delivery is built on secure, reliable, scalable enterprise foundations. 

What you'll do:

  • Lead and develop the Enterprise Data delivery team, including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Domain Enablement Engineers, and Data Governance specialists. 
  • Establish clear delivery operating rhythms for planning, prioritization, capacity management, roadmap tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and stakeholder communication. 
  • Turn enterprise data strategy and business-domain priorities into sequenced, achievable delivery plans across platform onboarding, source integration, data-product delivery, semantic enablement, and governance. 
  • Partner with business leaders and domain stakeholders to shape intake, clarify intended outcomes, assess readiness, prioritize use cases, and establish realistic delivery expectations. 
  • Ensure domain work is appropriately scoped and sequenced, balancing near-term business value with the need for durable, governed, reusable data foundations. 
  • Coordinate delivery across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Domain Enablement, and Data Governance; resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that require platform, architecture, security, infrastructure, or executive direction. 
  • Ensure team outputs meet expectations for production readiness, data quality, documentation, ownership, lineage, security, access controls, and maintainability. 
  • Review delivery plans, technical approaches, risks, and tradeoffs with technical leads; challenge work that creates unnecessary duplication, ungoverned data assets, or unsustainable operational burden. 
  • Partner with the Sr. Staff Data Engineer to align domain delivery to shared ingestion, transformation, and deployment patterns. 
  • Partner with the Staff Analytics Engineer to ensure domain assets align to enterprise semantic standards, metric definitions, and Gold-layer promotion expectations. 
  • Partner with the Platform / Data Reliability Engineer to ensure domain workloads meet platform standards for reliability, observability, cost management, environment promotion, and secure production operation. 
  • Partner with the Data Governance Specialist to ensure ownership, stewardship, classifications, metadata, lineage, quality expectations, and approvals are incorporated into delivery work. 
  • Hire, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing data team; establish role clarity, growth expectations, performance feedback, and appropriate technical leadership opportunities. 
  • Define and monitor practical measures of delivery health, including roadmap progress, throughput, time to enable new domains, adoption, quality trends, operational stability, and unresolved dependencies. 
  • Communicate delivery progress, material risks, investment needs, and tradeoffs clearly to business and technology leadership. 
  • Continuously improve the team’s delivery model as the enterprise data platform, domain portfolio, and organizational maturity evolve. 

Required qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience across data engineering, analytics engineering, BI/data platforms, data architecture, or related technical data disciplines. 
  • 3+ years of experience leading and developing technical teams responsible for data, analytics, data products, or data-platform delivery. 
  • Demonstrated success leading delivery across multiple business domains and balancing competing stakeholder priorities.
