  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 8+ years of experience in defense, aerospace, UAS, missile, or maritime hardware development
  • Experience with propulsion electronics: motor controllers, power distribution/conversion, flight controller circuits, or electromagnetic actuators

  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-882E, MIL-STD-2105, or DoD Weapons Safety Board processes

  • Familiarity with avionics design standards: DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160
  • Experience scaling electronics designs to production volume, including DFM/DFT considerations
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and shaping technical practices at the team or program level

Yes, you heard that right! We want to pay you to blow stuff up!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own structural mechanical design for the vehicle primary structure
  • Perform structural analysis: FEA and hand calculations
  • Select materials and protective coatings for marine environments
  • Define structural interfaces with propulsion, buoyancy, energy, and payload systems

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested war-fighting domain.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Own the thermal design and analysis of a space vehicle or payload program 
  • Use first principles as a basis for every decision and discern the right level of analysis to apply. Execute hand calculations, spreadsheet, and MATLAB/Python first-order models to inform path forward before jumping into detailed design 
  • Define worst case thermal environments across the vehicle mission lifetime 
  • Define system thermal budgets and requirements through collaboration with engineers in other disciplines 
  • Drive thermal architectures and hardware definitions, such as radiator sizing, coating selections, heater power allocation, MLI definitions, thermal interface material selections, thermal management techniques, and trading heat transport devices 
  • Support PCBA thermal analysis and electronic component thermal management 
  • Own the development, planning, and execution of unit and system thermal vacuum, thermal balance, and thermal cycle tests 
  • Develop internal tools to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of analysis 
  • Develop, prepare, and execute thermal tests to inform analysis and reduce risk on key hardware assemblies 

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • BS, MS, or higher degree in engineering, applied physics, or hard science 
  • Demonstrated knowledge of heat transfer in academic and/or professional setting  
  • Application of first-order hand calculations to drive thermal architectures and verify accuracy of higher fidelity models 
  • Proficiency in Thermal Desktop or equivalent thermal simulation tool 
  • Thermal experience with spacecraft components such as optical payloads, electronics, mechanisms, etc. 
  • Hands-on experience prototyping hardware and conducting thermal tests  
  • Experience with CAD, selecting instrumentation, post-processing data, correlating models 
  • Ability to independently navigate and solve complex, open-ended technical problems in a fast-paced environment 
  • CAD experience (Siemens NX preferred) 
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to communicate pros/cons of system architecture with respect to thermal considerations 
  • Passion for defending the United States and her allies 
  • U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Highly proficient using Thermal Desktop (3+ years) 
  • Design or test experience on a space platform 
  • Experience developing code in higher-level languages like Python or MATLAB for applications like lumped thermal capacitance steady state and transient analysis 
  • Experience with full life cycle of space hardware development, from concept to on-orbit operation 
  • Experience using FloCAD and SINDA/FLUINT 
  • Experience with driving implementation of passive and active thermal control hardware 
  • Be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

  • You’re genuinely curious and creative, wanting to dive deep into a variety of operational process and systems problems and think critically to define optimal solutions

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Sentry Planning team is looking for a Supply Planner to own the supply and production strategy for a set of complex hardware assemblies and product lines. This person sets the supply strategy, shaping what we need to build, in what quantity, and how far ahead of demand signals, so that annual production commitments and customer ship dates are achievable. Material Planning owns clear-to-builds and day-to-day material execution; You own the strategy that puts Planning and your product lines in a position to succeed.

To be clear about scope: you do not own the demand forecast, you own what supply plan to support it. Demand signals here move fast. The right person for this role has ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.
  • Work with Demand Planning and Production Program Management partners to align production throughput and build plans with actual demand plans.
  • Own the end-to-end supply and production plan for assigned assemblies and product lines, translating volatile, incomplete, and sometimes conflicting demand signals into a firm supply plan.
  • Set the inventory strategy and production plan for your scope, including safety stock, lead time offsets, production throughput, and proposing weekly production work orders.
  • Sequence the build schedule and allocate constrained material across programs when supply can't cover all build signals.
  • Protect Annual Planning commitments and customer ship dates. Pressure-test requests that put them at risk, and escalate early with options.
  • Drive recovery with cross-functional partners when supply breaks. Partner with Material Planning and Purchasing to expedite, de-expedite, or re-source; work with Engineering on substitutions and change timing; keep Manufacturing Engineering and Production partners current on what's moving and when.
  • Report on supply and material health in a way that forces decisions rather than describing status, covering coverage, risk, aging, and excess, along with your recommendation on each.

  • 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.
  • Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.
  • Strong analytical capabilities - create and analyze complex models that automate the identification of any supply shortfalls
  • Proactive, able to take substantial responsibility across various functions, with a focus on speed and accuracy.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce
  • Strong experience with Slack/Teams and Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Irvine, CA.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air Defense team develops, integrates, and fields autonomous systems that find, track, and defeat threats in the sky while keeping operators in control of engagement decisions. The team brings together Roadrunner, Sentry, Anvil, Pulsar, and Wisp with existing and third-party sensors and effectors through Lattice, creating a software-enabled family of systems for the modern battlespace. As control of the air becomes more contested, these networked capabilities give warfighters the awareness and response options needed to protect forces against rapidly evolving UAS threats.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are hiring a Systems Engineer for Anduril's air defense work with the U.S. Army. The portfolio fields counter-UAS systems that bring together Pulsar, Wisp, and other Anduril and third-party sensors, effectors, and communications, and they have to work wherever the Army needs them. Some are deployable systems, held ready and set up on short notice at a site the customer chooses. You will start on one of those, taking it from requirements and design reviews through integration, validation with the government, and sustainment, and your scope will follow where the portfolio needs engineering over time.

You own a defined part of the system's technical scope and the evidence that it works, inside a technical baseline set by the portfolio's technical lead. In practice that means requirements and verification, integration and calibration, the procedures and training material field teams depend on, and engineering support once the system is fielded.
The role is hands-on. You will spend real time with the hardware: configuring and integrating it, running calibration and test at the range, diagnosing problems from logs and data, and traveling to the site when a problem needs someone at the equipment. Fielded systems often have to work with no engineer on site, so much of the job is making sure the procedures and configurations you write hold up in someone else's hands.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own requirements and verification for your scope. Write and maintain the requirements and verification records, tie each requirement to a test, and produce and defend your portion of formal design reviews. Present your results in customer and program reviews.

Integrate, calibrate, and test the hardware. Configure and integrate systems before they ship, and run them through burn-in, calibration, and test at the range. Keep interface documentation matched to what the hardware actually does.

Equip the people who run it. Write the site requirements, setup and calibration procedures, checklists, and training content that field teams and operators use. Keep fielded systems ready through maintenance, software updates, and configuration tracking, so what deploys matches what was validated.

Support the system in the field. Root-cause issues from logs and data, lead technical recovery for your scope, and travel to the site when the problem needs hands on the equipment. Bring what you learn back to the product teams that can fix it.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Engineering, science, or other technical degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of systems engineering or related engineering experience on hardware and software systems
  • Ownership of a subsystem, interface, or other defined technical scope through verification and fielding, with accountability for whether it actually worked, not only for its design artifacts
  • Ability to explain the architecture and interfaces of a subsystem you owned, and a record of keeping interface documentation consistent with observed behavior
  • Ability to turn a defined scope into clear requirements and verification steps, then plan and run the test that shows it works
  • Experience debugging on real hardware and real data, including root-causing field issues with limited supervision
  • Experience presenting your own results to a technical working group or customer, and producing your portion of a formal design review
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time on average, with periods of up to 50% during test events and deployments
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Experience with deployable or expeditionary systems that are set up, calibrated, and torn down in the field
  • Experience writing procedures, checklists, or training material that operators or technicians executed successfully without you present
  • Depth in at least one of: radar, passive RF detection, electro-optical and infrared sensors, tactical radios and networking, or command and control software
  • Experience sustaining equipment held in reserve or storage, including preventive maintenance, software currency, and battery health
  • Experience developing and executing the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process to achieve and maintain an Authority to Operate (ATO) for a fielded system
  • Experience delivering counter-UAS, air defense, or force protection capability to a U.S. Army customer
  • Comfort on the Linux command line, and with Python for parsing and visualizing test data
  • Prior military service, particularly in Army air defense or an expeditionary unit

  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident response related to identity systems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Identity and Access Management.
  • Thorough understanding of IAM principles and modern security concepts, including Zero Trust, Least Privilege, Adaptive/Risk-Based Authentication, Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), Continuous Access Evaluation, and Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR).
  • Strong expertise in IAM protocols and standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and other federation protocols.
  • Strong expertise in IAM and federation protocols, with proven experience in architecting and implementing end-to-end federation solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with major IAM platforms, particularly SailPoint, Okta, PingOne, and Microsoft identity solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), Cloud IAM services, Terraform, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong scripting and programming skills in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with extensive experience developing IAM workflows, automation, and integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and drive projects from design through implementation.

This high-visibility role requires the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates extreme ownership, a collaborative no-ego mindset, and is comfortable taking the lead. SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Supervisor, OSP Fiber will lead a team of five fiber technicians responsible for installing, splicing, testing, and maintaining outside plant fiber infrastructure for a new data center. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set daily priorities, own crew safety and quality, and still work in the field alongside the team. You will be accountable for schedule, as-built accuracy, and delivering a reliable OSP fiber plant from construction through turnover and ongoing operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire, train, schedule, and develop a team of fiber technicians; provide coaching, performance feedback, and coverage planning
  • Plan and assign daily OSP work (aerial and underground placement, vault/handhole work, splicing, terminations, and testing) to meet data center construction and cutover schedules
  • Lead by example as a working supervisor; perform splicing, testing, and field work as needed
  • Enforce safety, PPE, lockout, traffic control, and utility-locate practices; stop work when conditions are unsafe
  • Own quality of splices, OTDR/OLTS results, labeling, and as-built records; drive rework to zero
  • Coordinate with OSP engineering, construction, utilities, and data center teams on design changes, access, and outage windows
  • Track production, quality, and material usage; report status, risks, and resource needs to leadership
  • Manage tools, fusion splicers, test equipment, vehicles, and fiber/consumable inventory
  • Ensure field work matches issued drawings and company standards; capture redlines and close as-builts with engineering
  • Support commissioning, emergency restoration, and after-hours work as required for a 24/7 data center environment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 5+ years of experience in fiber optic OSP installation, splicing, testing, or maintenance
  • 2+ years of experience leading technicians (supervisor, foreman, or team lead)
  • Hands-on proficiency with fusion splicing and fiber test equipment (OTDR, OLTS, or equivalent)
  • Willing and able to work in the field, including outdoor construction conditions, and to work nights, weekends, or overtime as needed

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate’s degree or trade certification in fiber optics, telecommunications, or a related field
  • Experience supervising OSP or data center fiber crews through new site build-out
  • Fiber certifications (FOA CFOT, BICSI, Corning, AFL, or equivalent)
  • Experience with aerial and buried fiber, conduit/duct banks, vaults, handholes, and building-entrance laterals
  • Familiarity with TIA/BICSI guidelines, NESC, locates, and local permitting/construction practices
  • Ability to read OSP drawings, splice diagrams, and GIS/route maps and to produce accurate field redlines
  • OSHA 10/30, first aid/CPR, or similar safety training
  • Strong communication, timekeeping, and work-order discipline; comfortable coordinating vendors and construction trades
  • Experience standing up a new team, including hiring, training plans, and tool/equipment setup

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Schedule varies depending on site operational needs; frequent overtime and weekend support is required
  • Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions, climbing, lifting up to 50 lbs., and working on ladders/lifts at elevated heights
  • Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, noise, heat, cold, and rain
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment

In this role you'll support senior accounting leadership by developing strategies that prioritize team development, scalability, and value creation. You will partner cross-functionally with key teams, build and maintain relationships, and collaborate to deliver results.

Our ideal candidate will have a high degree of curiosity, initiative, and independence to hit the ground running, getting deep into work prepared by the team and identifying opportunities for improvement. We value problem solvers who are not satisfied with the status quo and who are energized by the chance to improve the efficiency or accuracy of existing processes.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support senior leadership by ensuring high-quality work produced by the team and by supporting one-off projects and initiatives.
  • Improve the overall quality and speed of accounting work-product delivery.
  • Build and leverage cross-functional relationships across the company to deliver greater value to Finance and other internal teams.
  • Exercise sound judgement and ensure that accounting conclusions are documented in reconciliations and technical memos in accordance with current policies and guidance.
  • Communicate and present complex topics to leadership in an accessible format while retaining the ability to work at a detailed level as needed.
  • Identify, design, and implement technology-enabled process improvements, leveraging internal tools to automate workflows, improve data quality and visibility, strengthen controls, and enable the Accounting team to focus on higher-value work.

  • Resourcefulness and the ability to solve problems, including non-traditional or undefined problems, creatively and analytically
  • The ability to calibrate a room of peers and stakeholders, achieve alignment, and pull levers to bring greater value to Accounting and other internal teams. The ability to work both independently and as part of a team, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, is essential. Experience partnering with international functions and teams is a plus.
  • Sound judgment and composure in high-pressure situations along with the ability to ground decisions in data to ask and answer questions that move the business forward, and demonstrate discretion and integrity in all interactions.
  • Significant experience with accounting and finance systems, implementations, enhancements, and overall use of technology to scale the function.

What We Require

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience, with at least 4+ years of experience at a large international public accounting firm.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; able to maintain accuracy in work products and multi-task in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Description:

In this role, you will design, implement, and flight-test autonomous shipboard recovery guidance for XBAT, with an emphasis on precision recovery to a moving ship in GPS-degraded and GPS-denied environments. Working within an established G&C team, you will own recovery guidance algorithms and their integration with relative navigation, flight controls, and recovery hardware. 

We are seeking someone with direct experience taking shipboard recovery guidance from algorithm development through implementation and flight testing. 

What you'll do:

  • Design and implement ship-relative guidance for approach, station keeping, alignment, and terminal recovery. 

    • Develop deck-motion compensation and landing-timing strategies that account for navigation uncertainty, aircraft response, control authority, and touchdown or capture constraints. 

    • Work closely with state estimation and sensing teams to define relative-navigation requirements and ensure recovery guidance remains robust to measurement errors, latency, and intermittent sensor availability. 

    • Implement recovery sequencing and contingency logic, including hold, wave-off, go-around, retry, and responses to degraded or lost navigation. 

    • Develop and integrate real-time guidance software in C++, working with flight controls, autonomy, embedded software, and recovery-system teams. 

    • Define recovery performance requirements and verify them through 6DOF simulation, Monte Carlo analysis, software-in-the-loop testing, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. 

    • Support test planning, flight readiness assessments, and flight operations. Analyze test data, diagnose performance shortfalls, and drive improvements between tests. 

    • Provide technical direction within the recovery-guidance effort, mentor engineers, and communicate design decisions, limitations, and test results across teams. 

Required qualifications:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, implementing, and flight-testing guidance laws for autonomous shipboard recovery, including recovery using relative navigation without GPS/GNSS. 

    • Strong understanding of moving-platform guidance, ship-relative reference frames, deck motion, and terminal position, velocity, and attitude constraints. 

    • Experience integrating guidance with relative-navigation systems and assessing the closed-loop effects of navigation bias, noise, latency, and dropouts. 

    • Strong background in flight dynamics and guidance and control, including the relationship between guidance demands, aircraft tracking bandwidth, and available control authority. 

    • Proficiency in C++ for real-time algorithm implementation and MATLAB/Simulink or Python for algorithm development and analysis. 

    • Experience executing verification and validation through simulation, hardware integration, flight testing, and post-flight analysis. 

    • Demonstrated ability to own a technical capability, resolve problems across subsystem boundaries, and work effectively with navigation, controls, software, and test engineers. 

    • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. 

Preferred qualifications:

    • Full-scale, at-sea flight-test experience with autonomous shipboard recovery. 

    • VTOL or rotorcraft experience involving precision recovery to constrained or significantly moving landing platforms. 

    • Experience characterizing recovery performance across ship motion, wind over deck, ship airwake, turbulence, and degraded visibility. 

    • Experience integrating vision, infrared, lidar, radar, or cooperative RF sensing into a relative-navigation and recovery system. 

    • Experience supporting ship–aircraft dynamic-interface testing, recovery-envelope development, flight safety, or airworthiness. 

    • Familiarity with Linux-based development, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. This is a partner-facing role: you'll support nonprofits, research institutes, academic medical centres and public-sector funders as they use Claude to get treatments to patients with rare and neglected diseases, where there is little or no commercial incentive to fund development.

The role focuses on two areas where we think Claude can help these partners today. The first is clinical trials.   • Build reusable infrastructure other institutions can adopt (MCP servers for biomedical data sources, agent skills, benchmarks grounded in real clinical questions), and feed what you learn in the field back to product, engineering and research.

  • Hands-on experience designing, running or analysing clinical trials, or finding new uses for existing medicines. Deep experience in one; both are a bonus. Having contributed to a regulatory submission for a trial is a plus.
  • Comfort with biomedical data: literature, omics, and real-world patient data (health records, registries, claims), ideally inside secure or trusted research environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a mid-to-senior Electrical Engineer to join our team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end avionics hardware development supporting advanced hypersonic and high-speed vehicles. You will own critical electrical subsystems from architecture and schematic capture through board bring-up, Design Verification Testing (DVT), and vehicle-level integration.

 

This role requires a strong grounding in electrical engineering fundamentals, deep experience in power electronics, and a desire to work in a fast-paced hardware development environment where you make real flight hardware move quickly.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (or related discipline) with 4+ years of hands-on experience in board-level circuit design, analysis, and system integration.
  • Strong EE Fundamentals: Demonstrated expertise in analog and digital circuit design, component selection, tolerance analysis, and root-cause troubleshooting.
  • Power Electronics Experience: Proven experience designing power systems, DC-DC converters, switching power supplies, voltage regulators, and power management circuits.
  • PCB Design Lifecycle: Direct experience designing multi-layer, mixed-signal PCBs (schematic capture, component placement, stackup design, impedance control, grounding, and design for EMC/EMI).
  • Hands-on Lab & Test Skills: High competence using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for hands-on board bring-up, debugging, and Design Verification Testing (DVT).
  • System Interfaces & Bus Architectures: Familiarity with common interfaces (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS-422/485, UART).
  • System Integration: Ability to take a design past the bench and support its integration into larger vehicle electromechanical assemblies and harness interconnects.
  • Clearance: Must be a U.S. Person with an active U.S. DoD Secret clearance (or eligibility to rapidly reactivate a clearance held within the last 24 months).

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance.
  • Experience designing electronics for space, missile, or hypersonic environments (accounting for extreme vibration, thermal vacuum, and radiation-tolerant/rad-hard considerations).
  • Experience with ECAD design tools such as Altium Designer.
  • Experience designing high-reliability hardware in fast-iterating environments (e.g., new-space, aerospace startups, or fast-paced defense programs).
  • Understanding of battery management systems (BMS), high/low voltage power distribution, and actuator/motor drive electronics.

The Intelligence Systems team is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

As an  Electrical Engineer in the Manufacturing organization you will design and build complex systems and PCBA platforms to test our products. Data acquisition and physical layer interfaces using FPGA, MCU, and off-the-shelf equipment will enable testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. You will work in a multi-disciplinary design team, managing requirements, capturing custom circuits, and designing complex assemblies and harnesses. You will work with firmware engineers to enable board support packages for embedded Linux, and bring up MCU RTOS platforms. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build things that test things. Design Circuits and Schematics that will be built into test automation platforms.
  • Integrate your designs into Anduril’s PDM systems. You will follow the same process for component design and release that our product design teams use.
  • Design and source PCB Assemblies with varying complexity - from FPGA based data acquisition boards, to MCU platform data interfaces, breakout boards, wiring harnesses, or peripheral modules.
  • Architect and source circuit board test fixtures, integrating your designs with internally developed and off-the-shelf data acquisition equipment.
  • Build internal library for test circuit for data acquisition, leverage your expertise for DFM / DFT.
  • Bring up, Debug, and Characterize circuits, low speed interfaces (I2C, SPI, CAN, etc.) and high speed signals (RF, memory, USB).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields OR 6+ years of advanced knowledge acquired through work experience and/or intellectual instruction in lieu of degree.
  • 4+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on product designs that have gone to manufacturing.
  • Experience with Professional Electronics Design packages (Altium, Cadence, PADs, etc.) for schematic capture and layout.
  • Expertise in PCBA Design. Ability to design and fabricate your own designs, or guide contract manufacturing resources.
  • Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.
  • Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems and releasing designs for production.
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with scripting tools Python for configuration and automation of setup tasks.
  • Familiarity with FPGA PCBA platforms - RTL, design synthesis, and bare-metal coding.
  • Master’s of Science in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Planning team is seeking a world-class Field Service Parts Planner to join our team. The Senior Field Service Material Planner has an integral role at Anduril, ensuring the availability of critical maintenance materials, spare parts, and consumables to support asset uptime and operational readiness across our deployed systems. This role encompasses material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain for Field Service & MRO items, from strategic procurement to their timely deployment in maintenance activities.

You will have full ownership of Field Service & MRO inventory planning and strategy for specific asset lines and deployments, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Maintenance teams on what and when to acquire, store, or deploy. This hire will be instrumental in accurately signaling and forecasting intermittent and critical Field Service & MRO demand, planning appropriate inventory levels, minimizing stockouts while optimizing costs, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware maintenance requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrated ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built, maintained, and deployed under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Plan, manage, and optimize Field Service & MRO inventory, including spare parts, consumables, and critical components, ensuring their availability when and where maintenance needs them.
  • Collaborate closely with Field Service, Maintenance, Operations, and Reliability Engineering teams to understand and anticipate demand for both preventative/scheduled and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive critical spares lists, especially for hazard zone deployments, establishing appropriate stocking strategies for highly variable and mission-critical items.
  • Design and implement effective inventory control strategies such as min/max levels, safety stock calculations, and reorder points, accounting for intermittent and event-driven demand patterns.
  • Monitor Field Service & MRO part usage, analyze failure rates, and collaborate with Reliability Engineering to drive continuous improvement in material planning and asset reliability.
  • Proactively identify and expedite at-risk materials or troubleshoot potential supply chain disruptions to prevent maintenance delays and protect asset uptime.
  • Foster strong cross-functional coordination with Maintenance, Operations, Deployment, and Procurement teams to ensure seamless material flow, improve visibility into demand, and align on Field Service & MRO strategies.
  • Ensure Field Service & MRO planning strategies and inventory management practices align with and fulfill O&S (Operations & Sustainment) contract requirements.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to right-size inventory levels, reducing excess while mitigating stockout risks for critical components.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)
  • 6+ years of experience in supply chain planning, inventory management, or MRO planning within a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace & defense, or technical environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment, with a focus on speed and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to be proactive, take substantial responsibility, and manage multiple priorities effectively.

The Head of Mechanical Strategic Supply Chain is a Director leadership role responsible for architecting and executing the sourcing strategy across all mechanical commodities. This includes precision CNC machining, structural castings and forgings, plastic and elastomer injection molding, advanced composite structures, sheet metal fabrication, mechanisms, and structural hardware/fasteners.

This role is critical to securing the advanced technologies and components that power our mission-critical hardware. you will navigate complex geopolitical landscapes, tightly regulated defense supply channels, and constrained global commodity markets. You will lead a high-performing team to build a resilient, scalable, and high-velocity supply chain capable of moving rapidly from New Product Introduction (NPI) to high-volume production. Partnering closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Executive Leadership, you will secure supply continuity against global market volatility, drive cost and technology roadmaps, and negotiate key commercial partnerships with global component manufacturers, distributors, and contract manufacturers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Enterprise Supply Chain Vision & Strategy: Define and execute multi-year global commodity and sourcing strategies across direct mechanical domains to drive cost reduction, supply chain resilience, and technology acceleration. This includes precision CNC machining, structural castings and forgings, plastic and elastomer injection molding, advanced composite structures, sheet metal fabrication, mechanisms, and structural hardware/fasteners.
  • Team Leadership & Scale: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of commodity managers, strategic sourcing leads, and technical sourcing engineers across multiple global sites.
  • Executive Supplier Relationship Management: Serve as the executive sponsor for Tier 1 suppliers, Contract Manufacturers (CMs), and critical technology partners. Establish long-term strategic alliances, joint development agreements, and robust performance management systems (QBRs, KPIs, scorecards).
  • Cross-Functional Engineering Alignment: Partner directly with Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, and Manufacturing from concept phase to drive DFM, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) cost optimizations, raw material selection, and process standardizations.
  • Commercial & Strategic Negotiations: Lead high-stakes negotiations for master service agreements (MSAs), development agreements, long-term supply agreements (LTSAs), and complex statement of works (SOWs)—optimizing pricing structures, IP protection, warranty, payment terms, and lead-time commitments.
  • Supply Chain Resilience & Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify single-source dependencies, geopolitical vulnerabilities, and capacity constraints. Drive proactive risk mitigation plans, dual-sourcing strategies, and strategic buffer inventory models.
  • Cost Architecture & TCO Modeling: Champion robust "should-cost" modeling, teardown analyses, and TCO evaluations to optimize value from concept through end-of-life.
  • Executive Communication: Conduct regular operational and strategic reviews with C-suite and executive leadership, serving as the primary executive escalation point for all critical supply chain matters.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in mechanical & structural strategic sourcing, global commodity management, or supply chain leadership within complex hardware manufacturing environments.
  • 5+ years of proven experience building, managing, and scaling high-performing procurement or supply chain teams.
  • Demonstrated expertise negotiating enterprise-level agreements and managing diverse commodity portfolios primary mechanical fabrication methods (5-axis CNC machining, composite layups/infusion, high-pressure casting, plastic injection molding, and metal stamping).
  • Proven track record of managing supplier lifecycles and negotiating complex multi-million-dollar commercial agreements.
  • Deep understanding of New Product Introduction (NPI) workflows and scaling from prototype to high-rate production.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%-50% domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa.

  • Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or related industry
  • Well-versed in TCO analysis and should costing to ensure data-driven analytics tied to component and supplier selection, in a product-based ecosystem
  • Strategic thinker, experienced putting together commodities strategy/roadmap with key engineering stakeholders
  • Proven leadership in driving and influencing other teams to a common goal. You know how to effectively communicate and collaborate cross functionally and with all levels within an organization
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security clearance

Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

You will plan and execute Powertrain integration and test activities across increasingly mature environments, from discrete bench tests through Hardware In Lab (HIL), Hardware In The Loop (HITL), surrogate platforms, and flight test. The Powertrain scope encompasses electric machines, inverters, gearboxes, battery modules, battery management systems (BMS), high voltage distribution, powertrain controllers, power conditioning, and associated thermal management systems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will own component and subsystem test campaigns end to end and contribute to vehicle-level campaigns led by senior engineering. All of this in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

  • Perform integration, bring-up, and characterization of electric machines, inverters, gearboxes, battery modules, BMS, high voltage distribution, powertrain controllers, and power conditioning components
  • Support development and operation of the Powertrain surrogate for integrated powertrain characterization and control tuning
  • Focus on the safety of integration environments, ensuring that potential harm to team members is eliminated by design, with particular attention to high voltage and stored energy hazards
  • Implement and maintain processes for configuration control of Powertrain integration environments

  • Adept at working safely with high voltage systems (400V+), including integration, checkout, test, and safe discharge procedures

  • Defense Industry background desirable

  • Produce and maintain tools to increase accuracy of work demand for new facilities and maturing processes using a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques
  • Identify and solve complex problems related to the movement of materials within a manufacturing environment.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join the Autonomous Airpower manufacturing team in Costa Mesa, California. You will support the manufacturing value chain for autonomous aircraft hardware — helping build the processes, documentation, and production capabilities that take hardware from design to the factory floor. This role spans the full breadth of manufacturing engineering disciplines and may focus on one or more of the following areas depending on your background: structures and composites, mechanical systems (landing gear, doors, actuators), fluid systems (hydraulic, fuel, pneumatic), propulsion integration, avionics, or harnessing and electrical integration.

This is a hands-on role for someone with a few years of manufacturing experience who is ready to take on more responsibility. You will work alongside senior manufacturing engineers, design engineers, and production technicians to build real aircraft hardware and develop the processes that make it repeatable. You will independently modify and improve manufacturing processes, analyze production data to drive decisions, and contribute to process documentation with increasing ownership. If you want to be on the floor as much as at your desk, this is it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support the manufacturing value chain for assigned aircraft subsystems or assemblies — contributing to process development, work instruction authoring, and production support
  • Independently modify and enhance manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and quality metrics on the production line
  • Author and maintain work instructions, quality plans, and inspection documentation with guidance from senior MEs
  • Analyze production data to identify trends and recommend data-driven process adjustments that reduce cycle times and increase throughput
  • Provide DFM/DFA input to design engineering — learning to identify manufacturability issues early and communicate them effectively
  • Support production builds on the floor — troubleshooting issues with technicians, documenting lessons learned, and iterating on processes
  • Develop and document standardized procedures that enhance manufacturing consistency and quality across build sequences
  • Assist with tooling definition and work with tooling engineers to validate fixtures and jigs for production use
  • Participate in root cause analysis for manufacturing non-conformances and help drive corrective actions
  • Support manufacturing BOM development and maintain accurate production documentation in PLM/ERP systems

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in aerospace, defense, or complex hardware production environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Electrical or Industrial Engineering or equivalent hands-on manufacturing experience
  • Foundational understanding of manufacturing processes — machining, assembly, composites, or electrical integration
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and CAD models
  • Experience analyzing production data and recommending process improvements
  • Willingness to work hands-on in a production environment alongside technicians
  • Strong communication skills — able to document processes clearly and work across engineering and production teams
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience supporting production or prototype builds on a factory floor in aerospace or defense
  • Exposure to one or more of the following: composite structures, mechanical systems, fluid systems, propulsion, avionics integration, or wire harness manufacturing
  • Experience with CAD tools (CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, or equivalent)
  • Experience with aircraft, UAV, or autonomous vehicle assembly
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing concepts or structured problem-solving methods
  • Familiarity with PLM/ERP systems (Teamcenter, SAP, Oracle, or similar)
  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance

  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians, providing guidance on routine assignments and manufacturing best practices

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering or equivalent hands-on manufacturing experience
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and refining manufacturing processes on a production floor
  • Experience authoring work instructions, manufacturing plans, and quality documentation for hardware builds
  • Proficiency with CAD tools (CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, or equivalent) for tooling and fixture design
  • Experience managing manufacturing engineering projects including timelines, vendor coordination, and resource allocation
  • Hands-on troubleshooting experience in a production environment
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Anduril’s Sentry Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. This role focuses on executing key tasks within the manufacturing value-chain for Sentry Tower Systems. This includes hands-on involvement in Design for Manufacturability (DFM) work, assisting with process creation and optimization, developing detailed work instructions, performing root cause analysis for production issues, and supporting quality planning for the hardware under your purview.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong desire to learn and contribute to complex electromechanical hardware challenges. You should be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment and enjoys getting hands-on to implement and refine physical solutions. If you are eager to apply your engineering skills to real-world production challenges and grow within a dynamic team, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Support the transition of new electromechanical products from NPI to production, contributing to Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) efforts, and assisting in establishing robust manufacturing processes to meet production demands.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for existing production lines and manufacturing processes, providing engineering support to resolve issues, enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality.
  • Assist in the design, implementation, and optimization of efficient manufacturing processes, supporting efforts to maximize throughput, reduce costs, and ensure consistent high-quality output for products.
  • Participate in projects for the installation, commissioning, and validation of new manufacturing systems and equipment, assisting with communication on their impact to production capabilities, efficiency, and capacity to stakeholders.
  • Assist in identifying and implementing automation solutions and integrated workflows to streamline manufacturing processes, enhancing efficiency and repeatability.
  • Develop and refine detailed manufacturing process flows, assisting in breaking down assemblies into logical subassemblies and sub-processes to optimize production flow and ensure consistent product quality on the line.
  • Create and maintain manufacturing documentation, including detailed work instructions, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality control plans, to ensure standardized and repeatable production.
  • Partner with contract manufacturers across diverse disciplines (e.g., PCBA fabrication, metallic manufacturing, final assembly) to support the establishment of repeatable production processes and ensure on-time delivery.

  • Provide Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) feedback to engineering teams, helping to optimize product design for production efficiency, cost, quality, and reliability.

  • Experience or familiarity with integrating assemblies/subassemblies
  • Extremely organized and detail-oriented

  • Experience in configuration management and change control processes

  • Prior experience working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle (ERP) or equivalents
  • Familiarity with establishing test ecosystems that de-risk hardware and meet target reliability levels.
  • Experience with Bill of Materials management.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to create and maintain user documentation across our diverse business lines. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of our products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Technical Writer, your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts. 

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate complex hardware and software systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well-written and presented artifacts. 

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. You will engage subject matter experts at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format. 

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available. 

Along with our commercial offerings outlined above, Anduril is pursuing Programs with the GOV, which require documentation in standards such as MIL-STD-40051D and S1000D, delivered via IETMs / IETDs. Familiarity with these standards and delivery methods is highly desired. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and operations to deliver task, conditions, and standard-centric documentation.
  • Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and considering input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions.
  • Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time and shared with leadership.
  • Help build a culture of technical documentation by contributing to the living documentation process, ensuring that those who come after you learn from your acquired Anduril experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation for complex hardware, software, or aerospace systems.
  • Experience writing technical, user-facing documentation.
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation (e.g., schematics, CAD, or software specs).
  • Experience building content in a variety of formats (Word, XML, DITA, etc.).
  • Strong written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on explaining highly technical subjects simply.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active security clearance.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local, to be onsite in Quincy, MA
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, etc.).
  • Passion for excellent documentation and user experience.
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD).
  • Experience delivering content on fast-paced, complex projects with multiple stakeholders.

About the Role

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking an exceptional Material Planner to drive material availability for cutting-edge defense hardware—spanning static sensor platforms, mobile ground equipment, and flight vehicles.
In this role, you will hold end-to-end material flow ownership across the value chain, from raw components through to finished goods. You won’t just manage tickets; you will own specific product lines and assemblies, serving as the critical link that dictates to Purchasing and Manufacturing exactly what to build/buy, how many and when.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, rapidly iterating environment where engineering designs evolve quickly. You possess a bias toward action, absolute accountability, and the problem-solving grit needed to ensure our production lines never miss a beat.

What You’ll Do

  • Production & Material Scheduling: Build, maintain and execute dynamic production plans. Translate engineering demand into executable build schedules, aligning closely with Strategic Sourcing and Purchasing to guarantee component availability
  • Clear-to-Build (CTB) Management: Maintain real-time shortage visibility across active programs. Generate actionable CTB reports to proactively flag risks, prioritize dock-to-stock material flow and prevent line-down situations.
  • Engineering Change Implementation (ECO/ECN): Partner directly with Hardware Engineering to assess inventory exposure, manage revision cut-ins and minimize scrap during rapid design iterations.
  • Supply Signaling & Forecasting: Provide forward-looking demand signals to Strategic Sourcing and Procurement for long-lead, custom mechanical and electrical components.
  • ERP & Master Data Hygiene: Take direct ownership of MRP parameters within Oracle (lead times, safety stocks, reorder points, scrap factors, and Bills of Materials) to ensure system recommendations reflect reality.
  • Consumables & Floor Stock Strategy: Design and manage replenishment strategies (e.g., Kanban, Min/Max) for production consumables, fasteners, and floor stock to ensure uninterrupted assembly.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate daily across Production, Quality, Logistics and Sourcing to reallocate materials, resolve Non-Conforming Material (MRB) holdups and expedite critical parts
  • Champion Process Improvement: Actively hunt for inefficiencies, manual workarounds and gaps across planning, warehousing and inventory systems. Don't wait for permission or instructions—take the initiative to design scalable solutions, rally cross-functional partners (Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, etc), and lead the charge from concept to execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of material planning, production control or supply chain experience in a high-mix or fast-paced manufacturing environment (e.g., aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or complex electronics).
  • Demonstrated Ownership & Initiative: A proven track record of identifying broken or inefficient operational processes and autonomously leading the charge to implement corrective, scalable solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex Bills of Materials involving electro-mechanical assemblies, wire harnesses or precision-machined structures.
  • Hands-on experience operating within ERP/MRP systems (Oracle strongly preferred; SAP, Netsuite or similar accepted).
  • Strong data manipulation skills in Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, index/match) to build models and shortage trackers from scratch.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 15–20%.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Irvine, CA (or relocate prior to starting).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience in NPI (New Product Introduction) environments where engineering changes occur frequently and rapidly.
  • Experience leading Kaizen events, value-stream mapping and/or cross-functional operational improvement projects that delivered measurable results in inventory accuracy, cycle time reduction or shortage prevention.
  • Self-starter mindset: A proven track record of resolving complex operational bottlenecks with minimal supervision and high agency.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Design & Construction team at Anduril delivers the factories, labs, offices, and secure spaces that enable our teams to design, build, and deploy advanced defense technology. Our projects span high-performance manufacturing facilities, mission-critical secure environments, and collaborative workspaces, giving our team exposure to a uniquely wide variety of technical and operational challenges. 

More than just delivering buildings, we are (literally) rebuilding the American defense industrial base. Our work directly accelerates how quickly critical technology moves from concept to production and into the hands of the warfighter. 

ABOUT THE JOB 

We are looking for a Principal Construction Project Manager to join our rapidly growing team. This position sits within the broader Design & Construction (D&C) team. The D&C team is responsible for bringing our various cutting-edge factories, offices, and secure spaces to life. We collaborate with a variety of stakeholders involved in shaping the built environment needed to enable Anduril’s mission (construction managers, architects, industrial engineers, real estate planners, finance analysts, and many more). But, first and foremost, we deeply listen to what our Division Leaders need. Whether it is autonomous submarines, robot fighter jets, or AR headsets, we stay close to our end users to ensure we’re fueling their success. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • External Project Management and Coordination: 
    • Maintain strong relationships with contractors, consultants, vendors, and regulatory agencies. 
    • Collaborate closely with external project management teams to ensure alignment of construction activities with overall project objectives. 
    • Facilitate regular meetings with external project managers to discuss project updates, resource allocation, and potential challenges. 
  • Stakeholder Management: 
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all construction-related matters. 
    • Advise in all phases of any given project: programming, design, pre-construction, closeout, and operations - not just construction. 
    • Communicate project progress, challenges, and solutions to senior management and other key internal stakeholders. 
    • Work cross-functionally with non-constriction functions like Security, Network Engineering, Facilities Management, Marketing, Kitchen Operations, Manufacturing, EHS, Legal, and many others. 
  • Budget and Financial Oversight: 
    • Develop and manage budgets for construction and maintenance projects: everything from large greenfield projects to small one-day capital improvements. 
    • Work closely with Finance/FP&A for cash flow forecasting. 
    • Prepare and present financial reports to senior executives. 
  • Contracting Strategy: 
    • Develop and implement creative contracting structures that align incentives, reduce change order disputes, and set up projects for success 
    • Establish commercial terms that drive transparency, predictability, and fairness throughout the project lifecycle 
    • Structure contracts to appropriately allocate risk, protect the company’s interests, and minimize potential disputes 
  • Construction Cost Estimating: 
    • Gather (and help define) user requirements for nascent construction projects. 
    • Generate accurate cost estimates at all stages of a project lifecycle (concept, test fits, schematic designs, construction drawings, etc.). 
    • Manage relationships with consultants, regional contractors, and suppliers as needed to support individual project cost estimates. 
    • Help build our historical cost database to inform every future project. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in construction management. 
  • At least 5 years of experience in a construction leadership role. 
  • Strong background in design advisory, pre-construction, and project kickoff/setup. 
  • Corporate Design and Construction experience including adept management of internal stakeholders.  
  • Proven track record managing the entire development lifecycle.  
  • Experience with Masterplanning, including phasing strategy, sequencing, and program-level scheduling for large-scale construction or facilities programs. 
  • Hands on experience overseeing change management.  
  • The ability to lead and effectively communicate with large, diverse project teams. 
  • Excellent project management skills, with a proven track record of delivering large-scale projects on time and within budget. 
  • In-depth knowledge of construction means and methods, materials, MEP systems and building codes. 
  • Competency in CPM scheduling methods, construction document review, and contract administration. 
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time to support a project or team meetings 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Experience with advanced manufacturing-related projects 
  • Excel proficiency: You can work quickly, you’re organized, and you build models that others can easily and intuitively pick up. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field. 
  • Experience with ICD-705 and TEMPEST-related policies and guidance is welcome

ABOUT THE TEAM

As Production Program Manager for Barracuda 500 International Growth, you will report to the Head of Production in overseeing the manufacturing and production lifecycle for our international expansion efforts. You will be responsible for launching production lines of Barracuda 500 products in partner nations/companies, while actively supporting new international opportunities. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, operations, quality, program management, growth, and leadership teams to ensure the successful execution of production programs globally. Your role is critical in driving efficiency, managing schedules, mitigating risks, and ensuring that international production efforts are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.

If you possess a good foundation for manufacturing operational excellence coupled with determination/grit, join us in shaping the future of military might. Your work will not only translate prototypes for scalable production but also change the balance of defense capabilities on a global scale. Apply now and become a vital part of our mission to secure a safer tomorrow.
 
Please note: There will likely be up to 50% travel required for this role, including international travel.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • International Production Launch – Lead the operational setup, line qualification, and launch of Barracuda 500 manufacturing, assembly, and test operations within partner nations/companies.
  • Support Growth Opportunities – Collaborate closely with the growth and business development teams to evaluate, scope, and operationalize manufacturing requirements for international pursuits, foreign co-production agreements, and industrial participation plans.
  • Process Optimization – Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production efficiency, scalability, and cost-effectiveness in support of partner-nation production facilities.
  • Budget & Cost Control – Monitor project budgets, track international production milestones, and ensure we are continually focused on identifying and solving issues to enable a successful transition to full-scale production.
  • Resource & Supply Chain Management – Coordinate the allocation of materials, tooling, and labor to meet production readiness goals, while assisting in the qualification and readiness of partner-nation suppliers.
  • Risk Management – Identify, assess, and mitigate operational, supply chain, regulatory, and technical risks that could impact international project timelines or operational readiness.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration – Coordinate between engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, program management, growth, and external partner company teams to align pre-production and launch efforts with business objectives.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Provide regular updates to internal leadership and foreign partner teams, ensuring transparency on project status, risks, and solutions.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or related field
  • 10–12+ years of experience in operations program management, production, or manufacturing, preferably in defense, aerospace, or complex hardware industries
  • Demonstrated experience launching new products, establishing new production lines, or executing manufacturing technology transfer programs
  • Experience supporting growth opportunities, proposals, and operational readiness assessments for new business initiatives
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain management, and production workflows
  • Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, TPS, Six Sigma, etc.)
  • Proficiency in project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Gantt Charts)
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities to influence and align cross-functional and cross-organizational teams
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%, including international travel
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or automotive manufacturing, especially with unmanned systems, aerospace structures, or munitions
  • Experience with international defense programs, foreign co-production, and export compliance regulations (ITAR/EAR)
  • Experience with ERP, MRP, MES, PLM systems

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role directly supports Anduril's Frontier Systems (AFS) Division. You will work alongside AFS growth, engineering, and program teams to translate a family of technologies, including radar, radio frequency, EO/IR, and defeat systems, into unified and winning proposals. You will need to bring strong copy editing skills and an analytical mindset to understand how internal strategy can be communicated to an external stakeholder; and ultimately, translate into wins. Direct experience with technical narratives, pricing strategies, and collaboration with legal, contractual, and executive teams are a must. WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • First and foremost you are a operator. Each day will require execution against a mixture of technical writing, brief preparation, CRM management, pricing, and editing.
  • Constructing the compelling narratives and compliant documents that drive Anduril’s business
  • Support Managers and Sr. Managers as they partner with myriad business and technical stakeholders to pursue long-term opportunities and execute Anduril’s capture, pricing, and outreach strategy through proposals, white papers, and other documents

  • Develop familiarity with AFS products and capabilities across its business lines to accurately represent the division's portfolio in proposal narratives and customer-facing materials

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Enable extremely accelerated/aggressive battery development timelines by burning down risks at the cell, module, and pack level via development testing
  • Support Battery System Engineers who support battery programs across Anduril with common test procedures/approaches at the cell, module, and pack level
  • Design tools and protocols to enable efficient documentation of test procedures/results without adding significant time or wasted effort
  • Write robust, modular data processing scripts and tools to efficiently provide plots/outputs that are required to enable informed system-level decisions
  • Based on BMS/algorithm requirements- design robust and pragmatic test procedures to be executed iteratively at the model-in-loop (MIL), software-in-loop (SIL), and hardware-in-loop (HIL) levels
  • Support validation of battery management system (BMS) algorithms, to include battery state handling, enable/disable switch (ie. contactor or FET) control, cell balancing, state-of-charge (SOC) estimation, state-of-health (SOH), state-of-power (SOP) power limits, fault handling, isolation monitoring, high-voltage interlock loop (HVIL), etc
  • Collaborate with Development Test and Battery Systems engineers to characterize battery cell equivalent circuit models and deploy them to battery HILs or simulations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related Engineering discipline, ideally with emphasis in battery development of some kind
  • 7+ years of professional experience in a related engineering field
  • Experience in an immersive interdisciplinary technical project (collegiate project teams or professional settings)
  • Demonstrated validation of battery cells and modules/packs against system requirements
  • Capability to compress timelines without sacrificing product quality by way of prioritization and brute force
  • Experience in hardware automation and software-hardware communication/integration
  • Demonstrated proficiency/utilization of Python or Matlab to process large data files into plots, summaries, metrics, etc.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or Computer Science with applied focus on battery management systems
  • Experience in BMS HW/SW validation methods- including software-in-the-loop (SIL/SITL), model-in-the-loop (MIL/MITL), and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL/HITL) testing
  • Experience in cell equivalent circuit model (ECM) development and deployment to battery management systems
  • Experience in battery characterization methods: mission profile validation, equivalent-circuit model characterization, cycle/calendar life assessment, safety features, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in battery modelling, controls, and module/pack integration
